**Middle School Athletic Trainer / Administrative Coordinator**




**Position Summary**


The Middle School Athletic Trainer / Administrative Coordinator is responsible for promoting the health, safety, and well\-being of middle school student\-athletes by providing comprehensive athletic training services while supporting the daily administrative operations of the Middle School Athletics Program. This position provides injury prevention, evaluation, treatment, rehabilitation, emergency medical care, and return\-to\-play management for student\-athletes, ensuring care is developmentally appropriate and aligned with school policies, state regulations, and athletic governing body guidelines.




**A Day in the Life**


As the Middle School Athletic Trainer / Administrative Coordinator, you'll spend your day supporting the health, safety, and success of our student\-athletes. You'll provide injury prevention, evaluation, treatment, rehabilitation, and emergency care while coordinating with families, coaches, and healthcare providers to ensure students receive the support they need.




In addition to caring for students, you'll manage athletic medical records, coordinate equipment and supplies, assist with game\-day logistics, and support the daily operations of the Middle School Athletics Program. During practices and competitions, you'll be on the sidelines providing immediate care and helping students safely return to play. Every day offers the opportunity to build meaningful relationships, promote student wellness, and contribute to a safe, positive, and inclusive athletic experience.




**Primary Responsibilities**

* Administer treatment for athletes’ injuries and conditions
* Create rehabilitation programs
* Maintain medical files for all athletes
* Provide athletic training supervision at all home events
* Create conditioning programs for injury prevention
* Create medical binders/bags for all athletic teams
* Refer athletic injuries to physicians for diagnosis and/or treatment (MS and US)
* Inventory, organize, and replenish athletic training room supplies
* Maintain a safe, clean, and organized athletic training room
* Comply with OSHA standards with regard to bloodborne pathogens
* Comply with HIPAA laws to ensure privacy and safety of information regarding athletes
* Use a variety of therapeutic modalities to prevent and treat injuries
* Ability to recognize life\-threatening situations and administer the appropriate emergency aid
* Monitor athletes completing all necessary paperwork to be eligible to compete
* Åssist the Athletic Director with daily operations and daily administrative tasks
* Assist with the development and maintenance of athletic calendars, schedules, and operational timelines.

jobs.description:
***SteppingStone Adult Day Health*** *is San Francisco's largest provider of adult day health care. Licensed by the State Department of Public Health and certified as a Medi\-Cal provider with the California Department of Aging, the organization has worked tirelessly since 1983 to help seniors and disabled adults thrive and overcome the obstacles to independent living by providing a cost\-effective, stimulating, and comprehensive set of health and social services. SteppingStone also operates three supplementary programs under the umbrella of adult day health care – Enhanced Care Coordination that focuses on community living and an aging\-in\-place approach, the LGBTQ\+ Community Services program and the Alzheimer’s Day Care Resource Center.* 

*The Enhanced Care Management (ECM) Project at SteppingStone is a program designed to provide comprehensive care coordination and management services to individuals with complex medical and behavioral health needs. The program is aimed at improving the health outcomes and quality of life for participants, many of whom are elderly or disabled and require multiple services and treatments. The program is funded through the California Department of Health Care Services and operates under the state's Medi\-Cal managed care program. ECM has been successful in improving health outcomes and reducing hospitalizations for participants, while also providing much\-needed support and resources to caregivers and families.*

**JOB DESCRIPTION – OUTREACH COORDINATOR**

**Job Summary:**

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible to lead strategic outreach efforts to marginalized older adult and adults with disabilities populations in San Francisco. The Outreach Coordinator reports to the Director of Services and Outreach and collaboratively establishes and achieves goals for successful outreach.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

· In collaboration with senior leadership, develop a strategic outreach plan for the agency.

· Identify, coordinate, and implement targeted outreach activities.

· Develop and maintain referral pipelines.

· Maximize centers’ utilization as evidenced by meeting average daily attendance (ADA) goals .

· Provide representation at meetings with other service providers to both be visible and facilitate referral of clients.

· Creation and distribution of materials to inform and recruit new clients.

· Perform media outreach and presentations.

· Direct outreach and recruitment efforts including speaking to referral sources, community groups, and performing door\-to\-door outreach activities.

· Primary liaison with centers’ program directors and social work assistants to assist with intake.

· Creating and maintaining a robust database of contacts, keeping clear records of referrals made both internally and externally for reporting purposes.

· Oversees data management and drafts reports as needed .

· Oversees creation of marketing materials.

· Implements person\-to\-person outreach and other tasks as needed.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

**Outreach Activities:**

· Help create major news articles about the program's activities and successes.

· Distribute fliers posted on public boards (i.e., grocery stores, malls) and service agencies.

· Initiate personal contact with all health services and facilities in the area (i.e., other Adult Day Health Care, hospitals, health clinics and agencies, social day care programs, home health agencies, churches, managers at senior housing, doctors).

· Initiate and maintain contact with the local hospitals, San Francisco Department of Public Health, low income residential building staff, the Area Agency on Aging and the local city information and referral sources to set up referrals.

· Present at area civic and religious organizations.

· Distribute materials (newsletters, fact sheets, etc.) to appropriate health and social service agencies.

**Qualifications:**

· Master’s Degree from an accredited school of social work preferred. BA in a social science with 2 years of experience providing social services in 1 or more of the fields of aging, health, or long term care services required.

· Knowledge of the physical, mental, and social needs of disabled adults and the elderly; have demonstrable aptitude working with the elderly, cognitively and physically disabled.

· Experience in marketing and outreach to marginalized populations.

· Experience in adult day support services (health) is preferred.

**Working Environment:**

Must be able to safely perform all physical and manual movements needed for job functions. Must be able to carry out job instructions promptly and willingly, and to follow established procedures accurately. And, must be flexible, positive and cooperative in solving problems and working with other staff in constantly changing and sometimes stressful circumstances.

**Physical Demands:**

The Outreach Coordinator must be able to move around the facility as well as sit at a workstation and transport oneself in the communities of San Francisco.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach forward with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to sit and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. ---------------------



Fujifilm’s Data Storage Solutions division provides magnetic storage tape to customers around the world, supporting mission critical data retention needs across a wide range of industries. Magnetic tape is recognized as a core component of modern data center infrastructure, valued for its reliability, cost efficiency, and low power consumption in large scale and long\-term data archival.


As AI workloads drive data volumes to grow at an unprecedented pace, demand for Fujifilm’s magnetic tape is expanding rapidly. To further accelerate this growth and strengthen our engagement with key hyperscale customers, we are adding an experienced Account Manager to our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maximizing revenue, building and maintaining long term relationships, and serving as a primary point of contact for purchasing, supply chain, engineering, and related functions within major hyperscale accounts.


**This position is remote and based on the West Coast.**


**Company Overview**
--------------------


"
At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission\-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

  

  

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one\-time\-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation. And if you’re interested in tape, check out our Industrial Products Division—they develop data storage solutions.  



  

We offer a collegial culture and a flexible work environment. Our headquarters is in Valhalla, New York, a quaint town just one hour north of New York City.  



  

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. "

Absolute Security is the enterprise cyber resilience leader. Our patented Persistence technology is embedded in the firmware of more than 600 million devices through partnerships with nearly 30 of the world’s leading device manufacturers, giving us an unbreakable, self\-healing connection to the endpoint that no other vendor can match. * Align tightly with Absolute’s regional field sales and broader alliances team so partner\-led and direct motions reinforce rather than collide.
* Embed Absolute into the partner offerings and plays where our firmware\-resilience and Secure Access portfolio creates the most differentiated value.
* Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers.
* Other duties as assigned by management

* Direct experience building or scaling relationships with carriers, telcos, or large national partners, ideally AT\&T, or comparable service providers.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of partners, prioritizing across them rather than over\-investing in one.
* Strong command of cybersecurity and/or enterprise mobility go\-to\-market; familiarity with endpoint security, SSE, ZTNA, or managed device services is a clear advantage.

* Ability to influence and build trust at both the executive and field\-seller levels inside large, complex partner organizations.
* A self\-starter with a hunter mentality comfortable creating joint plans from a blank page and orchestrating internal teams without direct authority.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive\-presentation skills. Willingness to travel across the US and Canada as needed.

 **Nice\-to\-have skills**

* Existing relationships within AT\&T or their partner ecosystems.
* Cross\-border (US and Canada) partner or sales experience.
* Experience with embed / OEM or managed\-service attach motions, where a vendor solution is built into a partner’s offering rather than simply resold.
* Background selling into or alongside public sector and regulated industries.

Bold Works Here — Launch Your Career at Pacific Office Automation

We partner with industry leaders like Canon, Ricoh, Sharp, HP, Konica Minolta, and Lexmark to deliver cutting\-edge business solutions backed by exceptional service. From office technology and managed IT to software and security solutions, we help businesses operate smarter every day.

Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**

**DESCRIPTION:**


Join our collaborative sales team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute as a Academic and Biotech Incubator Bioscience Account Manager (BAM) supporting our legacy Life Technologies research portfolio that includes brands such as Gibco, Invitrogen, Applied Biosystems, Peprotech, eBioscience, Molecular Probes, Dynal, EVOs. You will increase revenue and build lasting relationships with customers while representing our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services. BAM portfolio encompasses reagents, consumables and instrumentation spanning across molecular, protein and cell biology. Working in a supportive environment that values achievement and innovation, you'll help enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. The BAM is the cornerstone for our commercial landscape, leading key sales activities around demand generation, closing, account mapping and collaborating with other commercial stakeholders including technical specialists and distribution partners.

**How will you make an impact?**  

This field\-based role is responsible for driving sales growth and managing key accounts across academic, government, and industrial customers within the assigned territory. You will expand existing business, develop new opportunities, and achieve sales targets through strategic account engagement, participation in scientific events, effective prospecting, and strong customer relationships. This role will be home based and requires the individual to be located in the Bay Area: East Bay, San Francisco or Peninsula, serving a territory supporting UC Berkley and biotech incubators in the East Bay and Peninsula.

**What will you do:**

* Consistently achieve or exceed sales targets by maintaining existing business, prospecting to develop incremental business, and conducting cold calls to develop new business in assigned accounts.
* Execute effective sales strategies, including prospecting, qualification, value\-based selling, and closing.
* Leverage product, application, and workflow knowledge to position solutions, deliver technical presentations and demonstrations, and drive customer adoption.
* Manage sales opportunities through disciplined pipeline management, including forecasting, next steps, and close plans
* Maintain strong customer relationships and engage key stakeholders across accounts
* Participate in sales meetings, seminars, and trainings
* Collaborate with internal teams and channel partners to deliver results
* Generate demand through holding office hours, 1:1 meetings, hall walking, business reviews and scientific seminars
* Create scientific intimacy with academic and small biotech companies
* Take market share from competitors

**Operating Cadence and Standard Work:**

* Field based customer engagement is expected 3\-4 days a week. Field location: Berkley, San Francisco, San Carlos
* Maintain a consistent operating rhythm to manage territory performance, including funnel management, account planning, and achieve KPI metrics.
* Routinely update CRM (Salesforce) to ensure accurate forecasting, pipeline health, and visibility to business performance.
* Prepare quarterly account and territory plans to define focused sales strategies and actions to achieve revenue targets, and mitigation plans to close gaps.
* Share market insights, competitive intelligence, and best practices with internal stakeholders.

**Who are we looking for:**

* Bachelor's degree required, preference in the field of Biology.
* 5\+ years of work experience, preferably in wet lab /scientific industries, or 4 years of work experience with a graduate degree
* Strong technical understanding of customer applications and workflows and position our products within the workflow
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in instrumentation, laboratory, or scientific sales
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships across all levels of an account and map key stakeholders, decision makers, and influencers.
* Understands the customer’s broader goals and challenges, using value\-based selling to influence decisions, solve business problems, and uncover growth opportunities.
* Experience working in a matrixed, collaborative environment
* Analytical and strategic planning capabilities
* Positive, can\-do attitude and ability to adapt to and embrace change
* Highly motivated to hit sales goals, and take share from competitors
* Fluency in English required; additional languages beneficial
* Commitment to Thermo Fisher's core values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong business acumen with ability to translate data into actionable sales strategies
* Strong understanding of academic grant, funding and publication dynamics \& biotech incubator environment
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills
* High level of personal accountability and rigorous execution discipline
* Proficiency with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and Microsoft Office
* Strong understanding of sales funnel management and forecasting
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 25\-50% within assigned territory, with occasional travel outside of territory for training
* Able to lift 50 lbs. independently
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Relocation assistance is NOT provided.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

 **Compensation and Benefits**


The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $80,000\.00–$115,000\.00\.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

jobs.title: Member Operations Associate (Oakland)
jobs.description:
**About Honey Homes**
=====================


Honey Homes is reimagining homeownership through a membership that makes maintaining a home effortless. Our members have a dedicated handyman who proactively cares for their home year\-round, helping prevent small problems from becoming expensive ones.


The **Member Operations Associate** is the evolution of traditional customer support. Rather than simply responding to members, you'll own member outcomes while helping improve the systems, tools, and processes that power the entire member experience.


Every day you'll work directly with homeowners, helping them solve problems and coordinating across teams to ensure they're taken care of. But that's only part of the job. You'll also identify recurring issues, improve workflows, leverage AI to eliminate repetitive work, and partner across the business to make Honey Homes better for both our members and our internal teams.


This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys helping people, loves solving problems, thinks in systems rather than one\-off solutions, and is excited about using AI and technology to fundamentally change how customer operations are run.


This is a hybrid role based in our Oakland headquarters (4 days/week in office).

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own the member journey**


Own member issues from beginning to end across app messaging, phone, SMS, and email. You'll coordinate across teams, communicate proactively, remove blockers, and ensure every member feels taken care of throughout their experience. Solving the immediate problem is expected. Owning the outcome is the standard.

### **Solve today's problems while eliminating tomorrow's**


Every recurring member issue should trigger a deeper question: *Why did this happen? How do we prevent it? Can we automate it? Should we document it? Does another team need to know?* Your job isn't complete when the ticket is resolved. It's complete when you've helped reduce the likelihood another member experiences the same problem.

### **Use AI to multiply your impact**


Leverage AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to eliminate repetitive work, improve documentation, automate workflows, and increase your effectiveness. We expect everyone on the team to actively experiment with new tools, test ideas, and continuously improve how work gets done.

### **Improve the member experience**


Member Success sits at the center of the member experience. You'll partner closely with Sales, Walkthrough Specialists, Field Operations, Billing, Product, Marketing, Recruiting, and other teams to surface trends, advocate for change, and help implement better ways of working. Our responsibility is the entire member journey, not just the conversations that reach our queue.

### **Own a functional area**


In addition to supporting members, every Member Operations Associate owns an area of the business. This might include onboarding, messaging, knowledge management, phone operations, AI tools, NPS, reporting, documentation, or another operational focus area. You'll become the team's subject matter expert and be responsible for continuously improving how that area operates over time.

### **Operate with high agency**


We don't wait for someone else to identify problems. We expect every teammate to proactively find opportunities, propose solutions, build improvements, measure their impact, and share what they've learned. Curiosity, ownership, systems thinking, and continuous improvement aren't nice\-to\-haves—they're core expectations of the role.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Within your first year, you'll:

* Deliver consistently exceptional experiences for Honey Homes members.
* Develop expertise in your operational ownership area and drive measurable improvements.
* Identify recurring member issues and help implement solutions that reduce future support volume.
* Build AI\-powered workflows and automations that improve efficiency across the team.
* Create documentation, SOPs, and knowledge resources that make the organization more effective.
* Become a trusted cross\-functional partner who proactively identifies opportunities to improve operations and follows through on delivering results.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


We're looking for people who care deeply about helping customers but are equally motivated to improve the systems behind the customer experience.


The strongest candidates will bring many of the following:

* 2\+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, operations, hospitality, or another customer\-facing role.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* High agency and a bias toward ownership \- you don't wait to be asked to solve problems.
* Curiosity and a desire to continuously improve how work gets done.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Sales Associate | Fine Jewelry & Luxury Client Experience
jobs.description:
Vardy’s Jewelers is seeking a polished, motivated, and sales\-driven Sales Associate to join our fine jewelry showroom team. This is an opportunity for someone who loves people, luxury, relationship\-based selling, and the art of creating meaningful client experiences.

This role is ideal for someone who is not simply looking for a retail position, but wants to build a long\-term career in fine jewelry sales with the opportunity to grow into future leadership over time.

At Vardy’s, our clients come to us for some of life’s most important moments, including engagements, weddings, anniversaries, milestone gifts, custom jewelry, repairs, and heirloom pieces. We are looking for someone who understands the importance of trust, professionalism, follow\-through, and creating a memorable experience from the first interaction to long after the sale.

**What You’ll Do**

Deliver an Elevated Client Experience

· Welcome clients into the showroom and provide a warm, polished, and personalized experience.

· Assist clients with engagement rings, wedding bands, fine jewelry, custom designs, repairs, special orders, and milestone purchases.

· Build strong client relationships through thoughtful communication, follow\-up, and attention to detail.

· Help clients feel educated, confident, and excited about their purchase.

· Represent Vardy’s Jewelers with professionalism, discretion, and care.

**Drive Sales and Build Client Relationships**

· Work toward individual sales goals while contributing to overall showroom success.

· Proactively follow up with clients, past customers, leads, and inquiries.

· Participate in clienteling, outreach, cold calling, and relationship\-building efforts.

· Look for opportunities to grow business through referrals, community involvement, networking, and local relationship\-building.

· Take ownership of your sales pipeline and demonstrate a strong sense of urgency.

**Learn and Grow in Fine Jewelry**

· Develop strong knowledge of diamonds, gemstones, metals, bridal styles, custom jewelry, repairs, and fine jewelry trends.

· Participate in training and ongoing learning to strengthen product knowledge and sales skills.

· Learn how to guide clients through emotional and high\-value purchasing decisions.

· Stay curious, coachable, and committed to becoming a trusted jewelry professional.

**Support the Showroom and Team**

· Help maintain a beautiful, clean, organized, and luxury\-level showroom environment.

· Assist with displays, merchandising, product presentation, inventory organization, and daily showroom operations.

· Support client appointments, events, promotions, and outreach initiatives.

· Work collaboratively with ownership, management, and the broader team to create a positive and service\-focused environment.

**Long\-Term Growth Opportunity**

For the right person, this role offers the opportunity to grow into a future Sales Manager position. This is not an immediate management role, but we are looking for someone with the potential to develop into a leadership position over time.

As you grow, you may have the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities such as:

· Supporting and coaching sales team members.

· Helping track sales goals and showroom performance.

· Assisting with clienteling strategy and business development efforts.

· Supporting team communication and daily showroom leadership.

· Helping create a goal\-driven, accountable, and client\-focused sales environment.

· Leading by example through strong sales performance, professionalism, and follow\-through.

**Who We’re Looking For**

The ideal candidate is:

· Sales\-driven, ambitious, and motivated by results.

· Warm, personable, and skilled at building relationships.

· Polished, professional, and comfortable in a luxury showroom environment.

· Trustworthy, dependable, and accountable.

· Competitive in a healthy way and motivated to grow.

· Comfortable with client outreach, follow\-up, and community networking.

· Able to work with urgency without sacrificing quality or client experience.

· Detail\-oriented and committed to providing excellent service.

· Coachable, team\-oriented, and eager to learn.

· Interested in a long\-term career opportunity, not just a short\-term job.

**Experience**

Fine jewelry experience is preferred, but not required for the right candidate.

We are open to candidates with strong sales experience in luxury retail, fashion, bridal, beauty, hospitality, watches, high\-end furniture, design, or other client\-facing sales environments.

Ideal experience includes:

· 2\+ years of sales experience required.

· 5\+ years of sales experience preferred.

· Luxury retail, fine jewelry, bridal, or clienteling experience strongly preferred.

· Strong communication and relationship\-building skills.

· Comfort working with sales goals and performance expectations.

· Ability to pass a background check.

**Schedule**

This is a full\-time, in\-person position.

Typical schedule:

· Tuesday through Friday, approximately 10:30 AM to 6:15 PM

· Saturday, approximately 9:30 AM to 5:15 PM

· Occasional evening events, approximately 5 to 6 times per year

**Compensation and Benefits**

Vardy’s Jewelers offers a competitive compensation package, including:

· Hourly compensation starting at $30 per hour, with potential up to $32 per hour based on experience and qualifications.

· Sales incentive opportunities.

· Company\-paid employee health insurance.

· Paid sick time/PTO in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

· Vacation eligibility after the first year.

· SEP IRA retirement contribution.

· Potential discretionary year\-end bonus based on business performance.

· Employee jewelry discounts.

· Hands\-on training and career development.

· Opportunity for long\-term growth into a future leadership role.

**Why Join Vardy’s Jewelers?**

Vardy’s Jewelers is a trusted, family/team\-oriented fine jewelry business where relationships matter,

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager: Digital Marketing Agency/Influencer Partners
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid\-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.  

ERP analysts in the mid\-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid\-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.  

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid\-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.  

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed\-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.  

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid\-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments. **Responsibilities**


ERP analyst relationships* Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid\-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR\-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid\-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
* Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
* Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid\-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
* Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid\-market platform to their audiences and clients.
* Track analyst\-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.

  

Digital marketing agency relationships* Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product\-market fit.
* Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co\-marketing and lead\-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
* Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid\-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
* Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co\-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
* Track agency\-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.

  

Portfolio management \& reporting* Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.
* Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co\-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.
* Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.
* Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go\-to\-market teams.

  

Cross\-functional collaboration* Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.
* Work with marketing to develop analyst\-specific content programs, agency co\-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid\-market ERP ecosystem.
* Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst\-generated content and recommendations.

 **Qualifications**


Required* 10\+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software company.
* Familiarity with the mid\-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community — you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.
* Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long\-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.

jobs.title: Edge Cyber Security Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**We Are:**

  

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. Technology is at the core of change today, and Accenture brings broad capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and a commitment to delivering outcomes that matter.

  

Accenture Edge is Accenture’s purpose\-built business serving high\-growth mid\-market organizations with annual revenues between **$300 million and $3 billion**. Leveraging the power of AI, data, cloud, and Accenture’s deep industry expertise, Edge helps clients accelerate digital transformation, drive operational excellence, and achieve measurable business outcomes through innovative, scalable, and right\-sized solutions tailored to their growth ambitions. By combining industry\-leading talent, proven methodologies, and strategic ecosystem partnerships, Accenture Edge enables organizations to reinvent how they operate, enhance customer experiences, and create sustainable value in an increasingly AI\-driven world.

 **To learn more about Accenture Edge, visit:** Accenture Edge \| Built for Your Scale

 **The Work:**

  

As an Inside Sales Representative, you will support the end\-to\-end sales process for standardized cyber security solutions for mid\-market clients in the United States, from initial needs assessment through deal closure. You will collaborate with Mid\-Market Account Success Management to support a smooth transition to delivery and client onboarding.


This is a digital\-first sales role. You will identify and progress opportunities through digital and social channels, including LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, AI and generative AI tools. You will also coordinate with marketing teams to develop points of view, support multi\-client campaigns and maintain a disciplined commercial pipeline.

* **Drive digital sales and opportunity identification:** Identify and progress cyber security sales opportunities through digital and social channels, building a consistent pipeline of standardized solution opportunities across the U.S. mid\-market.
* **Support end\-to\-end sales of standardized solutions:** Own the sales process for straightforward, well\-defined cyber security solutions, from initial needs assessment and solution positioning through commercial negotiation and deal closure.
* **Coordinate across marketing channels:** Partner with marketing and campaign teams to create and share cyber security points of view, execute multi\-client outreach and deliver consistent messaging to U.S. mid\-market audiences.
* **Create client\-facing content:** Support the development of insight\-led points of view, campaign content and client\-facing collateral in partnership with cyber security subject matter experts and marketing teams.
* **Manage client contacts and communications:** Maintain accurate records of client contacts, interaction history and pipeline status in Salesforce or an equivalent CRM, while ensuring timely and professional communications throughout the sales cycle.
* **Leverage AI and generative AI:** Use AI\-enabled tools to source opportunities, personalize outreach, accelerate research and progress opportunities efficiently.
* **Enable a smooth transition to delivery:** Collaborate with Mid\-Market Account Success Management to ensure a well\-documented handoff from sale to onboarding.
* **Maintain pipeline accuracy and reporting:** Own the accuracy of pipeline data, contact records and sales activity logs. Provide clear reporting on pipeline status, campaign performance and conversion metrics.

 **What’s In It for You**:

  

* Contribute to a high\-growth cyber security initiative focused on the U.S. mid\-market.
* Work at the intersection of sales, marketing and technology while building skills in digital selling, campaign management and cyber security commercialization.
* Develop toward career pathways in cyber sales, account management or marketing leadership.
* Build capability in digital selling, AI\-enabled tools, CRM discipline and cyber security market knowledge.
* Join a collaborative, high\-energy team that values creativity, commercial focus and disciplined execution.

  

Travel may be required for role. 0\-80% depending on client and business needs.


  

**Here’s What You’ll Need:**

  

* 3\+ years of experience in inside sales, digital sales or demand generation for technology, cloud or cyber security, with experience supporting standardized solutions from initial contact through close. Including hands\-on experience with digital selling and social channels, including LinkedIn and Sales Navigator, and practical use of AI or generative AI tools to source, research and progress opportunities.
* 3\+ years strong CRM discipline, including maintaining accurate contact records, pipeline data and activity logs in Salesforce or an equivalent platform. 3\+ years selling experience of contract value for $2 mn.
* 3\+ years engaging with potential clients and clearly articulating a value proposition.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate's degree, must have minimum 6 years' work experience).

 **Bonus Points If You Have:**

  

* Experience planning, executing and evaluating marketing or demand\-generation campaigns.
* Experience developing client\-facing collateral that supports engagement and pipeline creation.
* Familiarity with marketing automation, pipeline analytics or reporting tools such as Power BI.
* Previous quota\-carrying or lead\-qualification experience in the mid\-market segment.
* A relevant CRM, digital marketing or sales technology certification, such as a Salesforce certification or equivalent.
* A technical background or a strong aptitude for understanding cloud technologies (e.g., DevOps, Data, AI)

This is a digital\-first sales role. You will identify and progress opportunities through digital and social channels, including LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, AI and generative AI tools. You will also coordinate with marketing teams to develop points of view, support multi\-client campaigns and maintain a disciplined commercial pipeline.

* **Drive digital sales and opportunity identification:** Identify and progress cyber security sales opportunities through digital and social channels, building a consistent pipeline of standardized solution opportunities across the U.S. mid\-market.
* **Support end\-to\-end sales of standardized solutions:** Own the sales process for straightforward, well\-defined cyber security solutions, from initial needs assessment and solution positioning through commercial negotiation and deal closure.
* **Coordinate across marketing channels:** Partner with marketing and campaign teams to create and share cyber security points of view, execute multi\-client outreach and deliver consistent messaging to U.S. mid\-market audiences.
* **Create client\-facing content:** Support the development of insight\-led points of view, campaign content and client\-facing collateral in partnership with cyber security subject matter experts and marketing teams.
* **Manage client contacts and communications:** Maintain accurate records of client contacts, interaction history and pipeline status in Salesforce or an equivalent CRM, while ensuring timely and professional communications throughout the sales cycle.
* **Leverage AI and generative AI:** Use AI\-enabled tools to source opportunities, personalize outreach, accelerate research and progress opportunities efficiently.
* **Enable a smooth transition to delivery:** Collaborate with Mid\-Market Account Success Management to ensure a well\-documented handoff from sale to onboarding.
* **Maintain pipeline accuracy and reporting:** Own the accuracy of pipeline data, contact records and sales activity logs. Provide clear reporting on pipeline status, campaign performance and conversion metrics.

 **What’s In It for You**:

  

* Contribute to a high\-growth cyber security initiative focused on the U.S. mid\-market.
* Work at the intersection of sales, marketing and technology while building skills in digital selling, campaign management and cyber security commercialization.
* Develop toward career pathways in cyber sales, account management or marketing leadership.
* Build capability in digital selling, AI\-enabled tools, CRM discipline and cyber security market knowledge.
* Join a collaborative, high\-energy team that values creativity, commercial focus and disciplined execution.

  

Travel may be required for role. 0\-80% depending on client and business needs.


  

**Here’s What You’ll Need:**

  

* 3\+ years of experience in inside sales, digital sales or demand generation for technology, cloud or cyber security, with experience supporting standardized solutions from initial contact through close. Including hands\-on experience with digital selling and social channels, including LinkedIn and Sales Navigator, and practical use of AI or generative AI tools to source, research and progress opportunities.

 **Bonus Points If You Have:**

jobs.description:
**HVAC Sales Representative** 

**Flow Masters Plumbing, Inc.**  
**Location:** San Francisco \& Peninsula, CA  
**Position:** Full\-Time HVAC Sales  
**Compensation:** Base Salary \+ Commission

**About Flow Masters Plumbing**

Flow Masters Plumbing, Inc. is a growing plumbing, heating, and HVAC company serving residential, commercial, and property\-management customers throughout San Francisco and the Peninsula.

We are expanding our **HVAC Division** and are looking for a motivated, professional **HVAC Sales Representative / Comfort Advisor** who can help customers understand their options and confidently guide them through HVAC replacement and installation projects.

**The Role**

This is a **sales\-focused position**. You will meet with customers who are considering replacing, upgrading, or installing HVAC equipment and developing solutions based on their property, comfort needs, and budget.

You will work closely with our HVAC technicians, installers, dispatch team, and management from the initial sales opportunity through project handoff.

**Responsibilities**

* Meet with residential and commercial customers for HVAC sales opportunities
* Evaluate customers' existing HVAC systems and comfort needs
* Recommend appropriate HVAC replacement and upgrade options
* Sell furnaces, air\-conditioning systems, heat pumps, ductless mini\-splits, thermostats, and related HVAC solutions
* Prepare and present professional estimates and proposals
* Clearly explain equipment options, efficiency, warranties, installation requirements, and pricing
* Follow up consistently on open and unsold estimates
* Maintain accurate customer notes, sales activity, and follow\-up information in the company CRM
* Coordinate sold projects with the operations and installation teams
* Build strong relationships with homeowners, property managers, and commercial clients
* Identify additional opportunities while maintaining a customer\-first approach
* Meet individual and company sales goals
* Participate in ongoing product, technical, and sales training

**Qualifications**

We are looking for someone who has:

* HVAC sales experience strongly preferred
* Knowledge of residential and/or light\-commercial HVAC systems
* Understanding of furnaces, AC systems, heat pumps, and ductless mini splits
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to explain technical information in a way customers can easily understand
* Strong follow\-up and closing skills
* Professional appearance and customer\-service mindset
* Ability to use CRM, estimating, and mobile technology
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record
* Strong organization and time\-management skills

Previous experience as an **HVAC Advisor, HVAC Sales Representative, HVAC Technician, or HVAC Installer transitioning into sales** is especially welcome.

Knowledge of boilers, hydronic/radiant heating, plumbing, or water heating is a plus.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

Flow Masters Plumbing offers a competitive compensation package, including:

* Base salary plus commission
* Commission opportunities on qualifying estimates sold
* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401(k)
* Paid sick leave
* Paid company holidays
* Company vehicle for qualified positions
* Fuel card
* Partial cellphone reimbursement
* Training and professional development
* Opportunity to grow with our expanding HVAC division

**Who We're Looking For**

We want someone who can combine **HVAC knowledge with professional sales ability**.

The right person is not simply looking to make a quick sale. We want someone who can listen to the customer, identify the right solution, explain the options clearly, follow up consistently, and build long\-term trust in Flow Masters Plumbing.

If you are experienced in HVAC and sales and want the opportunity to help grow an expanding HVAC division in the San Francisco market, we would like to hear from you.

* You hold yourself responsible to commitments
* You value being part of a team
* You want to keep learning, improving and developing as a leader

	+ *Safety*

	+ *Innovation*

**Minimum Requirements:*** **No Experience Required!! Sales experience preferred**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required

* Ability to obtain the appropriate pesticide license/certification if required (company paid)
* Ability to work in the field independently and interact with our great clients

jobs.description:
**Please Note:**


The work territory of this position is the **Livermore, CA area.** You must live less than 1 hour away from the territory (including traffic) or willing to relocate on your own (relocation is not approved for this position) before your hire date.

  

Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Sysco’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.  



  

**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Car allowance (mileage reimbursement for candidates in CA) and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

 **JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.
* Other duties may be assigned.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

 **Required Education/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Culinary Arts or related discipline **OR** HSD/GED and 3 years Restaurant Management, B2B or outside sales experience, or equivalent relatable experience.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bi\-Lingual
* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

 **Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations**

* Valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company insurability standards.
* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

 **Requirement**

* Pass employment testing
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.title: Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
#### **Development Operations Coordinator**


#### **Support Mission\-Driven Fundraising Operations That Make a Difference**


#### **$66,000\- $73,000**



**THE ROLE**
Win \- Women in Need is seeking a detail\-oriented and organized Development Operations Coordinator to support the daily operations of our development team. This role is critical to ensuring the accurate processing of donor contributions, maintaining donor records, supporting fundraising campaigns and events, and helping provide excellent donor stewardship.

Reporting to the Manager, Gift Processing \& Research, the Development Operations Coordinator will play a key role in gift processing, CRM administration, reconciliation support, event data management, and overall Development Operations functions. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, processes, and systems while contributing to an organization dedicated to ending homelessness for women and families.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
* Process donor gifts accurately and timely, including checks, credit cards, wire transfers, stock gifts, and donor\-advised fund contributions.
* Generate and distribute donor acknowledgment letters and stewardship communications.
* Maintain accurate donor records and data within Salesforce.
* Perform data quality reviews and ensure the integrity of donor information.
* Prepare deposit documentation and support gift reconciliation processes with Finance.
* Maintain organized records and supporting documentation for gifts, deposits, and donor activity.
* Support fundraising campaigns and events through data entry, donor tracking, and reporting.
* Respond to donor inquiries and provide administrative support to the Development team.
* Process Development mail and gift\-related correspondence.
* Participate in cross\-training and support other administrative projects as assigned.
* Communicate workload status, processing needs, and operational issues proactively.


**WHO YOU WILL BE**
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM/database systems preferred.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Passionate about the mission of supporting women and families experiencing homelessness.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Comfortable working with data, systems, and documentation in a fast\-paced environment.
* A collaborative team player who communicates effectively with colleagues across departments.
* Able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines and maintaining confidentiality.
* Preferred Qualifications
* 1\-3 years of administrative, nonprofit development, gift processing, database management, or related operational experience.
**WHY JOIN WIN?**
At Win, your work directly contributes to helping women and children achieve housing stability and independence. As part of our development team, you'll support the fundraising operations that make our life\-changing programs possible while building valuable experience in nonprofit development, donor relations, and CRM management.

Join us and help create opportunities that transform lives every day.
Equal Opportunity Employer  

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Workplace & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**



For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry\-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world's most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.



Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. Global Relay is a career\-building company. A place for big ideas. New challenges. Groundbreaking innovation. It's a place where you can genuinely make an impact – and be recognized for it.



We believe great businesses thrive on diversity, inclusion, and the contributions of all employees. To that end, we recruit candidates from different backgrounds and foster a work environment that encourages employees to collaborate and learn from each other, completely free of barriers.

**Your role**



We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Workplace \& Events Coordinator to support the effective operation of our New York office. Reporting to the Manager, Workplace \& Office Operations, you will coordinate workplace services, facilities support, vendors, meetings, visitors, and office\-based events. This is a hands\-on role that requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to anticipate needs and manage changing priorities as the office grows.


**Your responsibilities**


* Support the day\-to\-day operation of the office, ensuring workplace services, shared spaces, supplies, and facilities needs are coordinated effectively.
* Coordinate with building management and external vendors to support maintenance, service delivery, purchasing, and other workplace requirements.
* Manage the logistics for meetings, visitors, and approved office\-based events, including space, catering, vendors, access, setup, and on\-site coordination.
* Maintain workplace and event calendars, operational records, invoices, vendor documentation, and other information with accuracy and consistency.
* Support office moves, seating changes, workspace readiness, and other workplace projects as business and capacity needs evolve.
* Partner with HR, IT, Finance, Security, Legal, and other teams on workplace\-related requirements, while identifying issues, anticipating needs, and escalating risks appropriately.
* Perform administrative duties through Outlook using scheduling assist.


**About you**


* 2\-4 years of experience in workplace operations, office coordination, facilities support, event coordination, hospitality, or a related corporate environment.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and follow through reliably.
* Excellent judgment, attention to detail, and a practical, solutions\-oriented approach.
* Clear and professional communication skills, with confidence working across employees, senior leaders, visitors, vendors, and building partners.
* Experience coordinating meetings, vendors, catering, or office\-based events, and proficiency with Microsoft Office.

**Working conditions**
 * Flexible with shift start and end time

  


**What you can expect:**



At Global Relay, there's no ceiling to what you can achieve. It's the land of opportunity for the energetic, the intelligent, the driven. You'll receive the mentoring, coaching, and support you need to reach your career goals. You'll be part of a culture that breeds creativity and rewards perseverance and hard work. And you'll be working alongside smart, talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with complementary knowledge and skills.



Global Relay is an equal\-opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.



We seek to ensure reasonable adjustments, accommodations, and personal time are tailored to meet the unique needs of every individual.



To learn more about our business, culture, and community involvement, visit www.globalrelay.com.

jobs.title: Live Events Production Coordinator, The Greene Space
jobs.description:
The Jerome L. Greene Performance Space at WNYC \& WQXR is looking for a **Live Events Production Coordinator** to join our The Green Space (TGS). The Greene Space is the live public embodiment of WNYC, WQXR and WNYC Studios' shows, as well as a producer of our own original programming . We produce 50\+ programs each season for in house and digital audiences, including discussions, debates, concerts, game shows, podcast tapings, and theatrical productions. The Greene Space also operates as a rental venue, hosting events for external clients and partners.  

The **Live Events Production Coordinator** supports the planning and execution of live events, including ticketed programming, show events, internal events, and rentals. Working closely with the Director of Event Operations and the rest of the Events team, show teams, clients, and internal partners, the Coordinator helps ensure events are well organized, properly staffed, and successfully executed from initial planning through event wrap. This position reports to the Director of Events and Venue Operations.  

Our live events producers must have relevant production experience along with excellent judgment, ability to manage competing deadlines, strong verbal and written communication skills, team spirit, and good humor. Join us if you’re curious, unflappable, able to thrive in a dynamic and evolving environment, and ready to do whatever it takes because “the show must go on” – and this can include anything from landing a big guest to unloading the dishwasher.

* Maintain timeline, run\-of\-show documents, production schedules, and event checklists.
* Serve as a point of contact for internal show teams, external clients, talent, and vendors, helping communicate schedules, requirements, and event details.
* Coordinate event logistics, including staffing, catering, security, facilities, equipment, guest and comp lists, ticketing, and other event needs.
* Work closely with technical and production staff to confirm audio, video, lighting, staging, recording, and livestream requirements as needed.
* Provide on\-site event support, including load\-in, setup, client and talent needs, audience arrival, event execution, and breakdown.
* Provide additional production and operational support as the live\-events portfolio grows.

  

MARKETING/PROMOTION:* Coordinate with Audience, Marketing, Social, Development, Sponsorship, Membership, and show teams to support event promotion, audience development, and revenue opportunities.

* Assist in admin responsibilities, including issuing SLAs, tracking invoices \& expenses, vendor contracts, and financial reconciliation.
* Maintain the events calendar, Airtable/database, production documentation, and event assets, ensuring information is accurate and accessible across teams and on the website..
* Support compliance with venue and organizational requirements, including insurance, accessibility, fire and safety regulations, and alcohol permitting where applicable.
* Conduct post\-event wrap\-ups and help track attendance, revenue, expenses, audience insights, and other key learnings.
* Coordinate food and beverage orders
* Partner with the Director of Events Operations and Sr. Director of Operations to audit, document and improve event workflows and contribute to maintaining an events production playbook.

 **Qualifications*** Strong organizational and project coordination skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills and comfort working with clients, talent, producers, vendors, and technical teams.
* Enthusiasm for a live production environment that sometimes requires shifting gears quickly or pressure to meet deadlines
* Ability to think critically, creatively, and proactively solve problems
* High EQ: You are intuitive and can easily work with and for diverse people with different capabilities and needs, whether they’re colleagues, talent, or audience members
* Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, calendars, databases, budgets, and project\-management tools.
* Love for live performance, art, and journalism and a commitment to highlighting the work of BIPOC artists and journalists
* Experience working for a media or performing arts organization is preferred
* Experience with event production, venue operations, ticketing, or live audio/video production is preferred.
* Availability to work evenings and occasional weekends based on the event schedule.

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator - Conrad New York Downtown
jobs.description:
The stunning Forbes 4\-Star **Conrad New York Downtown** is looking for a **Sales Coordinator** to join the Sales Team!


Stay inspired and join the pinnacle of luxury in the heart of Lower Manhattan, featuring 463 rooms, 30,000 square feet of banquet space, and 3 food and beverage outlets. This includes a 3\-meal restaurant, rooftop bar, and in\-room dining.


***Want to learn more?*** Hotel Website , Instagram, Facebook, YouTube  



**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a **Sales Coordinator** , you’re not just supporting sales operations and lead generation to help drive new business – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.


  
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:


* **Perform daily sales operations:** Provide administrative support including data entry, invoice distribution, Salesforce activity tracking, and recordkeeping to ensure efficient team operations
* **Support sales documentation and reporting:** Assist with preparing contracts, proposals, RFP responses, client call summaries, and booking and loyalty reports
* **Generate and qualify new business leads:** Research, identify, and evaluate unmanaged and prospect accounts to build and maintain a qualified pipeline
* **Build collaborative relationships:** Partner with Hilton Worldwide Sales peers, customers, and hotel partners to identify and qualify new opportunities, conduct discovery calls for unmanaged accounts, and deliver tailored solutions
* **Assist with special projects and events:** Support departmental initiatives, customer engagement activities, and participation in meetings and conferences as needed

  
**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:


A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.


  
**How We'll Help You Thrive**

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:


* **Incredible travel perks** – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
* **Own a piece of Hilton** – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
* **Paid parental leave** – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
* **Personalized caregiving support** – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
* **Crisis concierge** – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
* **Mental health resources** – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best\-in\-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* **Generous paid time off (PTO)** – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
* **Health \& welfare benefits** – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
* **Financial security for your future** – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next

*\*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.*


  
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**  

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.
