jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Vascular Services
jobs.description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative \- Vascular Services  
Employment Type: Full\-Time  
Location: New York City, NY  
Travel: Local travel required throughout the territory  
Reports To: VP of Operations  


Position Summary  


We are seeking a motivated and personable Business Development Representative to develop new business relationships with nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, assisted\-living communities, rehabilitation centers, and other healthcare facilities.  


The primary responsibility of this position is to identify facilities that could benefit from our vascular services, establish relationships with administrators and healthcare decision\-makers, educate them about our services, and develop referral partnerships that generate new business.  


This is a relationship\-driven, field\-based sales position for someone who enjoys meeting people, making connections, and developing long\-term business relationships in the healthcare community.  


Key Responsibilities  


Identify and develop relationships with nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, assisted\-living facilities, rehabilitation centers, and other healthcare organizations.  
Research and identify potential facilities that have a need for vascular services.  
Contact facility administrators, Directors of Nursing, Medical Directors, case managers, discharge planners, and other appropriate decision\-makers.  
Attend Quality meetings at facilities  
Schedule and conduct in\-person visits and presentations with facility leadership and healthcare staff.  
Explain our vascular services and how we can support their residents and patients.  
Develop referral relationships and establish our company as a trusted vascular\-service provider.  
Follow up consistently with prospective and existing facility partners.  
Maintain a pipeline of prospective facilities and track contacts, meetings, referrals, and business opportunities.  
Work closely with our clinical and operations teams to ensure a smooth transition from referral to patient care.  
Attend healthcare networking events, industry meetings, and community events to develop new relationships.  
Identify opportunities to expand services within existing facility relationships.  
Maintain accurate records of business\-development activities and report progress to management.  
Meet established goals for facility outreach, meetings, new relationships, and referrals.  


Ideal Candidate  


The ideal candidate is a self\-motivated, outgoing, and persistent relationship builder who is comfortable approaching healthcare organizations and developing business from the ground up.  


Experience in healthcare sales or business development is preferred, particularly experience working with:  


Nursing homes  
Skilled nursing facilities  
Assisted\-living facilities  
Home health agencies  
Hospice organizations  
Hospitals  
Rehabilitation facilities  
Physician practices  
Long\-term care organizations  


Candidates with strong sales, networking, marketing, or healthcare relationship\-building experience will also be considered.  


Qualifications  


Previous experience in business development, sales, healthcare marketing, or account management preferred.  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.  
Comfortable making cold calls and conducting face\-to\-face meetings.  
Professional and confident when speaking with healthcare administrators and clinical leadership.  
Highly organized and able to manage multiple prospects and relationships.  
Self\-directed and able to work independently.  
Reliable transportation and willingness to travel to healthcare facilities.  
Ability to build trust and maintain long\-term professional relationships.  
Familiarity with the long\-term\-care and senior\-care healthcare environment is a plus.  


Performance Expectations  


Success in this position will be measured by activities and results such as:  


Number of qualified facilities identified.  
Facility visits and decision\-maker meetings.  
New facility relationships established.  
New referral partnerships developed.  
Referral volume generated.  
Growth of business within existing facility accounts.  
Consistent follow\-up and maintenance of the sales pipeline.  


Compensation:  


We are open to structuring compensation with a base salary or hourly rate plus performance\-based incentives tied to successful business development and new facility relationships.  


Why Join Us?  


This is an opportunity to play a key role in expanding access to vascular services for residents and patients in long\-term\-care and assisted\-living communities.  


The successful candidate will have the opportunity to build a healthcare referral network, develop meaningful professional relationships, and directly contribute to the growth of the organization.

Power is where hustle meets purpose. It’s where leadership opportunities, life\-enhancing benefits, and award\-winning culture come together. Why? Because our people are our most important asset. And there’s no better investment than their happiness and growth.

**The Sales Role**


Hiring Immediately \- As a full\-time sales representative, we’re preparing you to succeed in more than just your current position. * Participation in ongoing sales training and coaching camps on a weekly basis
* Team building and mentorship

* Highly developed communication skills
* Ability to speak publicly with confidence and poise
* Self\-motivated, discipline, and career oriented
* Open\-minded with a passion for learning a wide\-range of skills that will carry through a variety of career paths
* Naturally outgoing individual who thrives in human interaction
* BA/BS preferred


**The Compensation**


* $3,900 Sign\-on bonus\*
* Hourly Rate plus uncapped commission and bonuses
* Average earning potential: $72,000 \- $130,000 per year

* Full medical, dental, life, and disability insurance plans that can be tailored to you and your family’s specific needs
* Subsidized child care and fertility benefits
* Paid parental leave
* Free health screenings \& rewards for participation in wellness programs
* A comprehensive 401(k) retirement savings program, matched by Power
* Ample paid vacation and holidays
* An employee\-relief fund

* Access to the latest technology, such as laptops, and tablets that will help you reach your sales goals faster and more efficiently
* Year\-round volunteer opportunities
* Personal development \- We provide books, courses and opportunity to attend leadership conferences
* Veterans encouraged to apply
* Artfully designed office spaces \& relocation opportunities


**Office Locations**


* Edison, NJ
* Princeton, NJ

  




* *Power offers a $3,900 sign\-on bonus, which will be paid weekly in $325 increments over the course of twelve weeks of initial training. The full sign\-on bonus is contingent on successfully completing the twelve weeks of initial training.*

jobs.description:
**APM / Project Coordinator – Transmission Customer Choice PMO (Project Management Organization)**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Assistant Project Manager, Customer Choice, will support the Customer Choice Project Managers in overseeing the development and execution of transmission line and substation capital construction projects within Georgia. This role involves assisting in various aspects of project management to ensure successful project delivery, high standards of quality, and stakeholder satisfaction. Additionally, the Assistant Project Manager may have the opportunity to independently manage smaller customer choice or relocation projects.  



**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Project Support:** Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of transmission line and substation projects, ensuring alignment with customer and business objectives.
* **Documentation and Reporting:** Review and collaborate project documentation, including schedules, budgets, and progress reports. Assist in the preparation of status reports and presentations for stakeholders.
* **Coordination:** Support the coordination of the design, engineering, procurement, construction, and closeout phases of project ensuring seamless integration and execution
* **Equipment Management:** Monitor and track major equipment of all projects including material slotting, review, and readiness.
* **Monitoring and Tracking** : Monitoring and Tracking: Monitor project progress, schedules, and budgets. Identify and report potential issues to the Project Manager.
* **Change Management:** Assist in managing project changes, ensuring all adjustments are effectively documented and communicated.
* **Stakeholder Management** : Assist in developing relationships with internal and external stakeholders to manage expectations, address concerns, and ensure a high level of satisfaction and collaboration.
* **Organizational Duties:** Assist and support project managers with managerial items that include but are not limited to scheduling and coordinating project meetings, note taking, and recording attendance.
* **Post\-Project Review:** Support the Project Manager in conducting post\-project reviews to identify lessons learned and share insights for continuous improvement.
* **Risk Management** : Help identify, assess, and manage project risks to minimize impact on project delivery and outcomes.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, or related field preferred.
* PE Certification and/or PMP a plus.
* 1 – 3 years of project management experience is preferred.
Experience in the electric utility industry is preferred.

* Basic understanding of financial analysis and budget management

Proficiency in project management software and tools

* Collaborative mindset with ability to work effectively with others.
* Ability to remain calm and composed under pressure.
* Ability to leverage new technologies and methodologies to improve project outcomes.
* Embrace feedback and use it as an opportunity for growth and improvement.

* Develop work plans to accomplish program goals and objectives and monitor progress toward their achievement.
* Serve as a liaison to and interact with individuals, groups, and organizations participating in the program or seeking knowledge of the program.
* Develop promotional and communication materials which may include content for reports, briefings, newsletters, grants or other written information related to the program.
* Coordinate with the law library to manage access to, update, and maintain the Feminism and Legal Theory Project Archive.
* Facilitate international visiting scholar program (including J\-1 and H\-1B visas) in conjunction with the International Student and Scholar Services office, supporting visiting scholars throughout their interactions with the VHC/FLT.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Hamlin Group is adding an Operations Coordinator to create operational leverage across the business — taking ownership of the administrative, coordination, and follow\-through work that currently pulls leadership away from design, sales, and high\-value client decisions.


You will work alongside company leadership and the Design \& Selections Coordinator, managing the day\-to\-day operational tasks that keep a luxury residential remodeling firm running. This is a developmental role. You will start by learning our systems, our standards, and how we operate. Over time, as you develop confidence and capability, you will take on more ownership and responsibility. What we are looking for is not someone who has done all of this before — we are looking for someone with a solid foundation, a sharp mind, and the drive to build the rest with our guidance.


We are a small company that operates at a standard most firms twice our size don't reach. That means every person on this team matters, dependability is a requirement, and when you say you have something, you see it through.

**Work Environment**

* On\-site — Chamblee, GA office
* Monday through Friday, standard business hours
* Occasional local errands or permit office visits as needed
* Professional, collaborative, and growth\-oriented culture

**The Right Person**


We are looking for someone who operates a certain way — not just someone who checks the right boxes on a resume.


You notice what others miss. You finish what you start. You create order out of ambiguity and don't require repeated reminders. You ask good questions, document the answers, and don't need to be taught the same thing twice. When something is off track, you communicate early. When a problem lands in front of you, your instinct is to solve it — not just report it. You can manage multiple workstreams without losing details, and you take pride in the fact that things run better because you are in the room.

 **Compensation:**
$65,000

 **Responsibilities:*** **Lead Management \& Client Communication** — Serve as the first point of contact for incoming leads. Field calls and emails, hold initial conversations to understand the project and determine fit, and manage lead information in our project management system. You are the first professional voice a potential client hears.
* **Invoice \& Expense Processing** — Manage trade contractor invoice processing, expense coding, and payment tracking with guidance from the project team. You will learn how our project budgets work and grow into running this process independently.
* **Trade Contractor \& Vendor Coordination** — Handle outbound communication with trade contractors and vendors — preparing and sending bid requests and work orders, following up on schedules and estimates, placing and tracking material orders, and coordinating the occasional pickup or delivery.
* **Project Administration** — Keep our project management system organized and current — setting up new projects, maintaining project files and records, monitoring daily log submissions, coordinating permit filings, maintaining office supplies, and supporting the team with basic quantity takeoffs when needed.
* **Technology \& AI Operations** — Work within AI platforms like Claude and ChatGPT as part of your daily workflow. We have built operational tools and workflows using these platforms, and this role will execute, manage, and help grow them. This is not casual AI use — it is a working part of how we operate.
* **Leadership \& Team Support** — Keep leadership on schedule with proactive calendar management. Coordinate with the design team on photography scheduling and warranty follow\-ups. When something needs to happen and nobody else is carrying it, you pick it up.

 **Qualifications:****Required**

* Strong organizational and communication skills — written and verbal
* A working familiarity with residential construction — you don't need to build a house, but you shouldn't be starting from scratch on basic terminology and concepts
* Comfort with technology and a genuine willingness to work with AI tools as part of daily operations
* Detail\-oriented with a basic understanding of invoicing, budgets, and payment tracking
* Self\-directed, dependable, and eager to grow into increasing responsibility
* Located in the Atlanta metropolitan area

**Preferred — Not Required**

* Experience in a construction, design\-build, or remodeling office environment
* Familiarity with construction project management software such as JobTread (our platform), BuilderTrend, or CoConstruct
* Experience with accounts payable or expense management
* Comfort reading residential floor plans
* Prior professional use of AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT

 **About Company**  

The Hamlin Group is an architect\-led, design\-build firm specializing in luxury residential remodeling in the greater Atlanta area. We are a small team that operates at a high standard — defined by craftsmanship, intention, and a refusal to cut corners. This role grows with the company, and the right person will find a long\-term home here.

**Our Mission**  

At The Hamlin Group, we set the standard for luxury home remodeling — driven by pride, precision, and purpose. We build spaces that inspire and a culture that refuses to cut corners — because excellence isn't our goal, it's our baseline.

**Our Core Values — H.A.M.L.I.N.**

* Honor Craftsmanship
* Attention to Design
* Measured \& Intentional
* Luxury Through Collaboration
* Integrity at Every Step
* Never Settle

jobs.title: Partnerships Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Remote role in the USA**

**Role Overview**

Uncapped lends working capital to e\-commerce sellers across the UK, US and Canada. Some of that business comes through partners: credit brokers, affiliates, agencies, software companies and embedded platforms who introduce sellers to us. Brokers are our largest partner group.


We are looking for someone to own that channel completely. You will decide which partners we go after, bring them in, get them referring, and be accountable for the revenue that comes out of it. It is a broad remit and a visible one. The channel's number is reported weekly and you will be the person who explains it.


You will have a proper stack behind you. PartnerStack is the partner system of record, HubSpot is the CRM, Clay handles enrichment and list building, Instantly and HeyReach run outbound, and Customer.io runs lifecycle comms. All of it is live and already connected, so your time goes on partners and programs rather than on setting tools up.


This is a hands\-on role. You will do the prospecting, build the campaigns and run the reporting yourself. Marketing will build assets you brief and Analytics will build you reporting you ask for, but nobody is dedicated to this channel. If you want to manage a book of relationships and have someone else own the pipeline, the tools and the numbers, this is not the right job. If you want a channel that is genuinely yours to run, it is.

**About Uncapped**

Founded in 2019, **Uncapped** is a leading fintech provider of working \& growth capital to e\-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting\-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e\-commerce platforms — including **Amazon and Walmart** — and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.

**What will you do ✍️**

**1\. Recruitment: bring new partners in**


Build and work the pipeline of new brokers, affiliates, agencies and platforms. Source lists in Clay, run sequences through Instantly and HeyReach, take the meetings, agree terms, and get them live in PartnerStack. You are doing your own prospecting.

**2\. Activation: get them to a first funded deal**


Signing a partner is the easy part. Getting them to send a first deal, and then a second, is where most partner programs stall. Own the path from signed agreement to first submission to first funded deal, and set yourself a time limit on it.

**3\. Top partners management: keep them close and keep them informed**


The partners who produce need real attention. Regular contact, honest feedback on what is converting and what is not, quarterly reviews, co\-marketing, early sight of new products. A lot of this is teaching. A broker who understands what we lend against and who we lend to will send better deals, not just more of them.

**4\. The long tail: run it as a program**


Most of the base will never justify a monthly call. Those partners still need to hear from us, so build the always\-on layer that reaches them: segmented Customer.io journeys, newsletters, product and rate updates, reactivation campaigns, and self\-serve material in the partner portal. Decide what good looks like for this group and measure whether the program is working.

**5\. Deal outcomes: own the channel's number**


Our AEs work the deals that partners send. You are still accountable for what happens to them. Chase deals that stall, unblock what is stuck in underwriting, make sure partners hear back, and fix routing when a deal sits with the wrong person. Close the loop with partners on declines and losses so their next submission is better.

**6\. Partner economics and commission**


Commission is a share of the fees we earn, and the rate varies by partner. You will run the payouts, keep attribution accurate, and understand what each partner costs us against what they bring in. Bring us recommendations on which rates should change.

**7\. Reporting and forecasting**


Own the weekly channel report and the forecast: applications, approvals, funded deals and originations, measured against plan. You will be the person who explains the number each week, including in the weeks it is bad.

 **Requirements** **Who you are**

**Must have**

* 3\+ years in partnerships, channel sales, or a similar commercial role. Lending, fintech, payments or e\-commerce SaaS is useful background but not essential
* A track record of building pipeline from scratch and converting it, whether that was partners, direct sales or something else
* Comfort owning a revenue number and reporting against a plan
* Working knowledge of a GTM stack. A CRM plus at least one of a PRM, a sequencing tool or a lifecycle marketing platform. You should be happy setting things up yourself rather than raising a request for it

**Nice to have**

* PartnerStack, HubSpot, Clay, Instantly, HeyReach or Customer.io specifically
* SQL, or a habit of building your own reporting rather than waiting for it
* Having worked on building a channel, rather than inheriting one that already ran

 **Benefits**  

At Uncapped, our people make us successful. We're a start\-up with big goals — we work hard, and we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. Some of what you can expect:

* Competitive base \+ uncapped commission — top performers earn meaningfully
* Unlimited holiday — well\-rested people make the best closers
* MacBook
* Personal growth fund — raise your game from great to spectacular
* Monthly recognition and awards — celebrate wins big and small
* The opportunity to close deals every day with **US e\-commerce founders** building real businesses

**We can only consider applications from candidates eligible to work in the USA without requiring visa sponsorship.**

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager: Digital Marketing Agency/Influencer Partners
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid\-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.  

ERP analysts in the mid\-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid\-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.  

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid\-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.  

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed\-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.  

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid\-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments. **Responsibilities**


ERP analyst relationships* Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid\-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR\-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid\-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
* Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
* Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid\-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
* Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid\-market platform to their audiences and clients.
* Track analyst\-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.

  

Digital marketing agency relationships* Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product\-market fit.
* Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co\-marketing and lead\-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
* Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid\-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
* Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co\-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
* Track agency\-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.

  

Portfolio management \& reporting* Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.

* Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About You:**Are you extremely organized? Do you take a proactive approach to solving problems? Do you act with integrity and hold yourself to the highest standard? If the answer is, "Yes!" then we have an opportunity that will excite you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.  



ARCO/Murray National Construction is currently looking for a detail\-oriented, self\-reliant Project Coordinator to join our team. At ARCO, you'll have the opportunity to improve project performance, set up processes and drive your own success from day one!  


**A Day in the Life:*** Typing/preparing various items such as letters, bid instructions, meeting minutes, weekly updates, memos, proposals, outline specifications, timesheets, and expense reports
* Assist Project Managers with Proposals by typing up proposal letters, outline specifications, manage the work/design schedule and assemble proposal books in a timely manner as per Project Manager
* Maintain various lists for Project Managers including job list for each region, subcontract tracking list, filing and vacation lists
* Prepare various forms as directed by Projects Managers (Subcontracts, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, AGC Agreements, Professional Service Agreements, and transmittals)
* Point person for proposal and capabilities packages. This includes putting together proposal covers, tabs, company information, sell sheets and then assembling once provided with rest of the materials by Project Manager
* Preparation for meetings and trainings including scheduling, preparing handouts, and coordinating lunches
* Book all travel when necessary
* Answer incoming phone calls and coordinate communication with vendors and customers in the event of a Project Manager's absence
* Maintain all files, including preparing new files and sending old files off site

  


**Necessary Qualifications:*** 3\-10 years of related experience, construction administration experience considered a plus
* Excellent computer skills, must be proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel
* Must be extremely organized, self\-reliant, proactive, and detail\-oriented

  


**What We Can Offer You:**We are dedicated to the well\-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.


* Industry\-leading performance\-based bonus program
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Traditional and Roth 401k
* Tuition reimbursement for associates
* Scholarship for associates' children up to $28,000 per child
* 1\-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel
* 1\-week paid volunteer leave each year
* 100% charitable match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* Paid parental leave


Typical base compensation for the Project Coordinator role is between $60,000 and $80,000\. Candidates with extensive experience may exceed this range. In addition to base salary, the role is eligible to receive discretionary bonus compensation based on individual and company.  



At ARCO, our first core value is to treat people fairly and do the right thing. We are committed to building and sustaining a culture that supports diversity and inclusion. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.



From recruiting, training, and hiring practices to selecting our subcontractors, we understand that diversity of all those involved in the construction process enhances our ability to deliver the best solutions to our customers. We hire the best and the brightest from across the country – constructing a team of experts in architecture, design, engineering, project management, and business services.

  


*\#LI\-AM2 \#LI\-Onsite***MAKE YOUR MOVE**



We are proud to be one of the fastest\-growing, privately\-owned companies in America, celebrating over 30 years of experience as design\-build experts. We have completed over 7,500 design\-build projects nationwide. We ranked \#9 on ENR's Design\-Build Firms list and \#34 on ENR's Top 400 Contractors list of 2026\. Most importantly, our clients like us, trust us, and want to do business with us. We are looking for people with the same enthusiasm, passion, and respect for the hard work that brought us to where we are today. Are you a person who can make a difference at ARCO? If the answer is "Yes!" we look forward to meeting you.


*ARCO does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies without pre\-approval from ARCO's Human Resources team. Pre\-approval is required before any external candidate can be submitted. ARCO will not be responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes and for candidates who are sent directly to our hiring managers. Agencies must have a fully executed vendor agreement in place as well as written approval to submit candidates from an ARCO TA Manager for a specific position before submitting candidates.*


**LEGAL DISCLAIMER**



EOE, including disability/vets

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Electrical
jobs.description:
This is a remote role within the United States. US work authorization is required.

 **About VIATechnik:**


VIATechnik is on a mission to lead the built environment in creating a better future, today. We are one team of over 500 digital experts around the globe. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed architects, engineers, tradespersons, researchers, and business leaders. Together, we empower clients through high\-quality, high\-velocity experiences that consistently improve outcomes across the design, construction, and operations of buildings and infrastructure. Our clients include Amazon, Mars Wrigley, and National Geographic, the firms shaping the world's most ambitious projects.

 **Role Overview**


VIATechnik is seeking a Project Coordinator to serve as the central hub keeping our electrical construction projects organized and moving forward. This role handles administrative and project management tasks, supports in tracking project schedules, attend internal and client\-facing meetings, and breaks down work to the appropriate engineering team. You'll support engineering teams by managing documentation and coordinating communication between internal engineers, clients, contractors, and vendors, ensuring projects stay on track, within scope, and within budget. This is a great fit for someone who wants hands\-on exposure to coordinate MEP/electrical engineering projects run from kickoff to closeout.

 **What You'll Do**

* Build a centralized documentation and tracking system across your assigned electrical projects, so meeting notes, RFIs, closeout files, and vendor submittals are logged in a consistent, searchable format within 48 hours of receipt.
* Screen incoming vendor product data and technical submittals against project specifications, catching missing information and formatting issues before they reach engineers and cutting down on submittals returned as incomplete.
* Track schedules and milestones across a portfolio of concurrent projects, and flag any timeline variance to the project manager within 24 hours instead of holding it for the next status meeting.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for routine client and contractor communications, resolving non\-technical questions yourself and routing technical ones to the right engineer without delay.
* Set up coordination meetings, help set up project timelines, join internal and client\-facing calls, capture accurate notes and action items, and follow up until every item is closed.
* Build working proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD within your first six months, opening project models on your own, pulling the views engineers request, and flagging obvious clashes or omissions ahead of coordination meetings.
* Reprioritize daily across competing deadlines as urgent vendor issues and client requests come up.

 **You'd Be a Strong Fit If**

* You have a PMP certification (strongly preferred)
* You have early\-career experience in project coordination, administration, or a related support role, ideally at an architecture, engineering, or MEP firm, and you're the person your team relies on to know where every document and deadline stands.
* You have coordinated projects in construction, engineering, or a related technical field.
* You can keep several projects moving at once and still notice when a date or a missing spec sheet is about to become a problem.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, clients, and contractors, and you know which questions are yours to answer and which belong with an engineer.
* You're curious about BIM and want regular, hands\-on time in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD, even if you're still building that skill set.

 **Why VIATechnik**


This role places you at the center of multiple active electrical construction projects, with regular exposure to new clients, contractors, and technical challenges. You'll work directly in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD models as part of your everyday work, and as your fluency grows, so does your ownership over vendor documentation, scheduling, and the projects you support. The role is built as a direct path into project management or BIM and VDC coordination.


The pace is fast and decision\-making can be informal. Engineers count on the coordinator to catch problems before they escalate. People who do well here enjoy bringing order to moving parts and stay steady when the plan changes.

  



**Win\-Win Statement**


VIATechnik needs someone who will take ownership of the documentation, scheduling, and communication that keeps electrical projects moving, freeing engineers to focus on design and technical coordination. In return, you get a direct path toward project management or BIM coordination, hands\-on exposure to the tools and projects that make that path real, and a role where your organization and follow\-through are visible in every project's outcome. This is a genuine trade: your reliability for our investment in your growth.

 **Compensation and featured benefits:**

* The pay for this position is **$75,000– $100,000**, and the role is eligible for bonuses. The actual salary offer may be different as we carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, location, and experience
* Health insurance with the choice of five plan options. We cover 70\-95% of premiums for VIATechies and 65% of the premiums for dependents (depending on the plan chosen)
* Dental and vision insurance. We cover up to 75% of the monthly insurance premiums for VIATechies and up to 50% of the premiums for dependents (depending on the plans chosen)
* Open and flexible time off
* A 401(k) plan that is fully vested immediately
* Home office setup costs
* Paid holidays

  

As a minority and woman owned and led company, VIATechnik seeks to build a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. VIATechnik is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for emplo

At ERC Pathlight, we're on a mission to change lives—and we're looking for people who feel called to do the same.



As one of the nation's leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma\-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence\-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.



Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world\-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.


### **Why Join Us**



When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You'll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission\-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.



Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. **You** matter.



If you're energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.


**Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.**


**What you'll be doing:**



Schedule: PRN (as needed) shift 6:30am to 7pm

The PCs provide structure and boundaries for our patients. They provide bathroom and milieu support as well as contribute to the implementation of therapeutic programming which may include care delivery and program documentation. The PCs provide mealtime support, supporting patients with their dietary needs, and supervising patients at meals and snacks.



The PC should be able to:


* Be willing and able to work at all ERC Pathlight local sites as assigned
* Be compliant with certification and regulatory requirements for each practice location
* Maintain a flexible schedule to meet organizational staffing needs

* Takes patients out on fresh air breaks and mindful movement exposures
* Provides ongoing bathroom monitoring

* Compliant with documentation in EHR for group facilitation

* Provides administrative support as needed around mealtimes
* Ensures adherence to allergy\-safety system
* Administrative Support
* Complete all appropriate documentation as needed in compliance with standards (some indicated above) including but not limited to patient observations, meals, and events that occur during shift
* Provides patient transportation as needed for medical appointments (may vary by location and program)
* Supports additional transportation needs, including but not limited to outings, grocery shopping, or other facility needs
* May provide support for additional food procurement as needed once per week
* Distributes mail and packages daily


**Must haves:**



Program Coordinator I (PC I)


* High School Diploma or GED (required)
* Valid driver's license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (required)
* Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (required)
* ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (required)
* Mental Health/Psych Tech or CNA certification (preferred)

* High School Diploma or GED (required)
* Minimum of one (1\) year of direct patient care experience (required)
* Valid driver's license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (required)
* Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (required)

* Bachelor's degree in behavioral health or related field (required)

* Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (required)
* ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (required)

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator II - Oak Park, IL - Rush Oak Park Hospital
jobs.description:
**Location:** Oak Park, Illinois


**Business Unit:** Rush Medical Center


**Hospital:** Rush University Medical Center


**Department:** Cancer Center\-Res Fac


**Work Type:** Full Time (Total FTE between 0\.9 and 1\.0\)


**Shift: Shift 1**

**Work Schedule:** 8 Hr (8:00:00 AM \- 5:00:00 PM)


**Rush offers exceptional rewards and benefits learn more at our** Rush benefits page (https://www.rush.edu/rush\-careers/employee\-benefits).


**Pay Range:** $27\.47 \- $38\.81 per hour
  

Rush salaries are determined by many factors including, but not limited to, education, job\-related experience and skills, as well as internal equity and industry specific market data. The pay range for each role reflects Rush’s anticipated wage or salary reasonably expected to be offered for the position. Offers may vary depending on the circumstances of each case.


This position is located at Rush Oak Park Hospital in Oak Park, IL.


Summary:
  

The Clinical Research Coordinator II (CRC II) independently coordinates assigned aspects of clinical research studies across a range of disciplines. Responsibilities include participant recruitment and retention, study data management, regulatory documentation submission and maintenance, communication with sponsors and institutional stakeholders, and monitoring of study compliance. The CRC II executes study protocols with increasing independence, identifies and resolves routine operational issues, contributes to process improvements, and may assist in mentoring less experienced staff.
  

Exemplifies the Rush mission, vision and values and acts in accordance with Rush policies and procedures.


Required Job Qualifications:
  

Education:
  

* Bachelor’s degree

Experience:
  

* 2\+ years of experience coordinating clinical trials
* Independent site management experience

OR
  

Experience (in lieu of a degree)
  

* 3 years total experience in coordinating clinical trials with increasing complexity

  

Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:
  

* Regulatory Knowledge – Understands Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and proper research documentation.
* Regulatory Compliance – Knows the basic rules and guidelines from NIH and FDA that apply to research.
* Project \& Time Management – Can manage timelines, keep track of tasks, and handle several study activities at once.
* Problem\-Solving \& Judgment – Can figure out solutions when challenges come up and make thoughtful decisions.
* Detail \& Organization – Pays close attention to detail and keeps study data and records well organized.
* Participant \& Vendor Interaction – Builds trust with participants and communicates respectfully with sponsors and outside partners.
* Communication Skills – Speaks and writes clearly when sharing information with research teams, participants, or external groups.
* Teamwork – Works well with other staff and helps solve problems as part of the team.
* Flexibility – Willing to work evenings or weekends if the study requires it.
* Travel Readiness – Able to travel locally or nearby for study visits, participant support, or training.

  

Preferred Job Qualifications:
  

Experience:
  

* 2\-5 years’ experience in clinical research conduct, regulatory management, or research administration

  

Certifications:
  

* Relevant certification strongly preferred (Certified Clinical Research Professionals (CCRP),
* Certified Clinical Research Associate (CCRA),
* Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC), OR
* Certified IRB Professional (CIP)
Job Responsibilities:
  

1\. Coordinates all aspects of the study including recruitment, consent, screening, scheduling, tracking, and provides study updates to study participants throughout the conduct of the study.
  

2\. May collect and enter data into study case report forms and/or electronic data capture system and respond to queries in a timely manner.
  

3\. Independently submits or partners with a regulatory coordinator to submit study related documents, study protocols, and study protocol amendments to the IRB per policy and procedure, with increasing autonomy over time to prepare for independent regulatory management responsibilities.
  

4\. Ensures procedural documentation is accurate, complete, and in compliance with institutional, local, state, and federal guidelines and regulations related to clinical research.
  

5\. Verifies and ensures that data is consistent with 100% of source documentation before entry into case report forms and electronic data capture systems to support accuracy, timeliness, and audit readiness.
  

6\. May collect, process, and ship potentially biohazardous specimens.
  

7\. May administer more complex structured tests and questionnaires according to research study protocols, including providing protocol\-specific education to participants regarding procedures and expectations. May utilize study\-related technology and equipment as part of assessment procedures.
  

8\. Provides ongoing study status updates, responds to questions, and may create summary report(s) for distribution to the PI, Administrator, department stakeholders, Sponsor, and Compliance throughout the conduct of the study.
  

9\. Organizes and participates in auditing and monitoring visits.
  

10\. Monitors participant interactions for protocol deviations, adverse events (AEs), and serious adverse events (SAEs), and reports findings per institutional and regulatory guidelines.
  

11\. Partners with PI(s), sponsor, compliance, clinical staff, and manager to identify and improve more complex processes as it relates to the conduct of the research study.
  

12\. May provide oversight, training, and coaching to less experienced staff.
  

13\. Other duties as assigned.  

  



Rush is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Representative – Account Management**

**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** Sales Manager, Account Management

**Position Summary**

Rensa Filtration is seeking a motivated Inside Sales Representative to manage and grow an assigned book of business. This is a phone\-forward sales position focused on developing customer relationships, re\-engaging inactive accounts, uncovering new opportunities, and expanding revenue across Rensa’s filtration products and brands.

The representative will own customer outreach, discovery, follow\-up, opportunity development, and pipeline management. HubSpot will serve as the primary system for documenting activity and managing next steps. The representative will work closely with Customer Service Representatives, product specialists, operations, and leadership to deliver a strong customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Proactively contact assigned customers and inactive accounts by phone and email.
* Build relationships with purchasing contacts, facility managers, maintenance teams, and other decision\-makers.
* Understand customer applications, purchasing patterns, challenges, and upcoming needs.
* Identify cross\-selling, reordering, reactivation, and account\-growth opportunities.
* Qualify opportunities and move them toward a clear next step.
* Schedule customer meetings and product discussions.
* Route quote requests to the appropriate CSR and provide complete customer and application information.
* Follow up on quotes, address objections, and help move opportunities to a decision.
* Maintain accurate notes, tasks, contacts, opportunities, and next\-activity dates in HubSpot.
* Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline tied to measurable revenue opportunities.
* Coordinate with customer service, product specialists, pricing, operations, and leadership.
* Escalate customer service, credit, pricing, or delivery concerns when appropriate.
* Participate in sales meetings, coaching sessions, and daily team discussions.
* Meet established activity, pipeline, customer\-coverage, and revenue expectations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous experience in inside sales, account management, business development, or B2B customer service
* Confidence making outbound calls and initiating customer conversations
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple customers, tasks, quotes, and follow\-up dates
* Experience using a CRM to document activity and manage opportunities
* Strong organization, time\-management, and follow\-through
* Ability to ask effective discovery questions and identify customer needs
* Comfortable being measured against activity, pipeline, and revenue goals
* Coachable, accountable, and willing to work within a defined sales process

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with HubSpot
* Experience in air filtration, HVAC, manufacturing, distribution, or industrial sales
* Experience managing and growing an existing customer book
* Familiarity with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Teams

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate combines the relationship skills of an account manager with the initiative of a salesperson. They are comfortable picking up the phone, creating opportunities, staying organized, and following through until the customer makes a decision. They understand that every customer interaction should result in a clear next step.

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance

* Vision insurance

* sales : 1 year (Required)

Made Better isn’t just a claim; it’s our Dare promise.

* Working with the R\&D and Innovation teams to create a robust innovation pipeline driven by consumer trends

Qualifications
  
* 1\-3 years of marketing, brand management, or related experience, preferably within a CPG company (inclusive of internship and co\-op experience)
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree within Marketing, Business or a related field is a plus.
* Passion to deliver results and think strategically
* Strong analytical skills paired with a creative mindset; Nielsen, Circana/IRI, or SPINS experience is a plus

* Demonstrated capability to manage fast\-moving projects successfully to completion
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
* Ability to build and maintain positive working relationships and to work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives
* A winning attitude including being results\-driven, collaborative and curious with the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams, agency partners, and external vendors preferred

jobs.description:
**POSITION:** Assistant Community Manager – 5150 NW Highway

**REPORTS TO:** Lead Community Manager

**DIRECT REPORTS:** None (may assist with directing site staff in Community Manager’s absence)

**POSITION SUMMARY** The Assistant Community Manager plays a critical operational and compliance leadership role, supporting the Community Manager in the administrative, financial, and physical management of the property. Serving as an intentional career pathway toward property leadership, this position holds primary accountability for recertification management and regulatory compliance while actively assisting with daily office operations, rent collection, leasing, and resident relations. The Assistant Community Manager ensures the property operates efficiently, meets all contractual and affordable housing guidelines, and upholds high standards of customer service and mission\-driven housing stability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Compliance and Recertification \[40%]**

* Own the resident recertification caseload, ensuring all annual and interim recertifications, gross rent changes, and unit transfers are completed accurately and within mandatory timeframes.
* Conduct applicant and participant interviews, gather third\-party verifications, complete calculations, and prepare thorough, audit\-ready compliance packages.
* Maintain compliance across all financing layers, including Section 42 (LIHTC), HUD, HOME, PBRA, Bonds, FHLB, and Section 811\.
* Maintain electronic and physical resident files in strict adherence to data security, Fair Housing, ADA, and auditing standards.
* Coordinate directly with state housing finance agencies, compliance auditors, and third\-party monitoring groups.

**Site Administration \[30%]**

* Support the Community Manager with daily administrative workflows, serving as the acting manager in their absence.
* Assist with rent collections, daily bank deposits, ledger adjustments, and delinquent account follow\-ups in accordance with local tenant laws.
* Draft and distribute general notices, lease violation notices, and legal documentation utilizing eviction\-prevention and de\-escalation strategies.
* Assist the Community Manager with accounts payable, invoice processing, and variance tracking.
* Maintain office organization, logs, reports, and administrative supply inventories.

**Resident Relations \[15%]**

* Serve as an escalation point for resident disputes, lease violations, and complex inquiries routed from the front desk.
* Educate residents on lease terms, program obligations, and recertification deadlines.
* Partner collaboratively with on\-site service providers to process reasonable accommodations and support resident retention.

**Leasing and Maintenance \[15%]**

* Process housing applications, maintain the property waitlist, verify eligibility, and execute initial lease signings.
* Monitor the Yardi service request dashboard to track ticket aging, conduct QA on completed tickets, and manage the administrative workflow for unit turns alongside the maintenance team.
* Assist with move\-in/move\-out inspections, annual unit inspections, and monitoring unit turnover readiness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Deep knowledge of affordable housing policies, HUD guidelines, and LIHTC compliance procedures.
* Proficiency in Yardi Voyager (or equivalent property management software) and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Strong organizational, mathematical, and analytical skills with rigorous attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with proven de\-escalation ability.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities independently in a fast\-paced environment.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2\+ years of affordable housing property management experience, with direct experience processing recertifications.
* Valid driver’s license, auto insurance, and reliable transportation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Tax Credit Certification (e.g., TCS, COS, HCCP, or BOS) or required within 120 days of hire.
* Prior experience with Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) and vulnerable populations.
* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, or related field.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Occasionally requires moving materials weighing up to 20 lbs.
* Unit and property inspections require walking, stair climbing, and general facility navigation.

**LOCATION AND TRAVEL**

* Based on\-site at 5150 N. Northwest Highway, Chicago, IL 60630
* **Schedule:** Full\-Time; non\-exempt; Monday–Friday, plus weekends/holidays as needed
* Requires occasional travel for regional meetings, trainings, or emergent support at neighboring portfolio properties.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**

**Salary:** $24\.00 \- $28\.00/hour, commensurate with experience


We believe in supporting the people who support our residents. Our benefits include:

* 11 days of paid vacation
* 12 paid company holidays
* 3 floating holidays
* Employer\-supported medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid parental leave
* SIMPLE IRA with up to a 3% employer match
* Employee Assistance Program
* Up to $5,250 annually for professional development and education assistance
* Opportunities for career growth within a mission\-driven organization

**REVIEW CYCLE** This job description is subject to a mandatory review every 24 months. Next scheduled review: December 2026\.

new_jobs.title: Territory Sales Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Territory Sales Account ManagerJob description:

Our company is a sanitation services company in the Western USA. We’re looking for an experienced Territory Sales Account Manager to build our large\-account presence in Orange County, California. This person will own the large General Contractor and large Event Company book in the territory — protecting and growing our existing relationships and hunting for new ones — while working closely with Operations to deliver on what we sell.

What You’ll Do

As Territory Sales Account Manager, you’ll own the top\-of\-market account development in Orange County — bringing large General Contractors and large Event Companies into the company on the strength of relationships and service, not just price. You’ll report to the Regional Director and partner day\-to\-day with the Assistant Operations Manager, Dispatcher, and CSR team to make sure what you sell is what we deliver.

You’ll be responsible for:

**1\. Bring Large\-Scale Customers to the Company:**

* Own the target list of large General Contractors and large Event Companies in the Orange County territory — Superintendents, Project Managers, Estimators, Procurement, and Event Producers
* Build multi\-touchpoint relationships that go beyond a single buyer — deep, durable relationships that don’t reset every time a project ends or a person changes seats
* Position the company on value, service reliability, luxury trailer capability, and event execution — not on price alone
* Represent the company at industry events, association meetings, and customer\-hosted events (AGC, ABC, DBIA, ISES, ILEA, IAVM, industry chapters)
* Develop and maintain account plans for each named strategic account — pipeline, project outlook, renewal calendar, expansion opportunities, and risk
* Negotiate contracts, MSAs, and pricing agreements with support from the Regional Director
* Maintain a clean, current CRM with account contacts, project pipeline, and activity notes

**2\. Create New Relationships from Scratch:**

* Hunt for new accounts through cold outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, project research, trade shows, and industry associations
* Build a personal outreach cadence — targeted calls, emails, and in\-person visits — sufficient to generate a healthy new\-business pipeline
* Convert warm leads and inbound inquiries into first orders quickly and reliably
* Establish yourself as a known name in the Orange County construction and events community over your first 6–12 months
* Approach unfamiliar customers with confidence — cold calls, walk\-ins on job sites, and introductions at events
* Move accounts from first\-order to repeat\-customer through follow\-up, problem\-solving, and personal attention
* Work with Marketing and Business Development on lead generation, digital presence, and territory awareness

**3\. Collaborate Effectively with Operations:**

* Partner day\-to\-day with the Assistant Operations Manager, Dispatcher, and CSR team on scheduling, service delivery, and customer communication
* Understand operational constraints — truck capacity, driver availability, service radius, plastics inventory, trailer availability, and lead times — before making commitments
* Never over\-promise on timing or scope; when a request is tight, work the tradeoff with Ops before committing to the customer
* Understand the pricing floor and margin expectations by service type; escalate below\-floor pricing rather than absorbing it
* Provide Ops with accurate order details — site access, hazards, timing, delivery windows, event schedules, permit needs
* Escalate scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or service risks to Ops and the customer before they become problems
* Communicate service issues back to customers proactively — own the customer relationship through the miss, not around it
* Debrief with Ops after service complaints or misses; close the loop and prevent repeat issues

Key Performance Indicators

* New named accounts won per quarter (large GC, large Event)
* Territory revenue growth vs. plan
* Gross margin on managed accounts (avoid winning on price alone)
* Pipeline coverage — active opportunities relative to quota
* Customer retention and expansion — dollars per account year over year
* Response time on customer inquiries and quotes
* CRM hygiene — accounts, contacts, activities, and forecast current
* Named\-account penetration — number of buying contacts per top account

Expectations

* Field\-forward posture — on job sites, at customer offices, at industry events, walking event venues
* Weekly pipeline review with the Regional Director; disciplined forecasting
* Direct, honest communication with both customers and internal partners
* Comfort with rejection and tenacity through long sales cycles typical of large GC accounts
* Ownership of customer outcomes — from first quote through renewal
* Alignment with and reinforcement of company Mission, Vision, and Values

Requirements

* 5\+ years of business\-to\-business sales experience with a proven record of hitting new\-business quotas
* **Must have:** experience selling portable toilets and portable sanitation services into the Construction industry, Event industry, or both
* Established network of relationships with Orange County General Contractors, Event Producers, or both
* Bathroom trailer / luxury restroom trailer sales experience preferred
* Strong hunting skills — cold outreach, prospecting, and comfort approaching new customers
* Ability to sell on value, service, and relationship rather than lowest price
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Proficiency in CRM tools; disciplined about pipeline and activity tracking
* Willingness to travel throughout the Orange County territory and adjacent markets as needed
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
* Commitment to safety, quality, and customer service

Compensation:

* Competitive base salary plus commission tied to new\-business acquisition, revenue growth

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
#### **About Us**



At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.



More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry\-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.



Award\-winning and people\-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider.


**The Role**



We're looking for a retention\-driven, customer relationship–focused Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team and own the post\-onboarding customer experience for a portfolio of medium to large healthcare practices.



At **SimplePractice**, we prioritize our customers' success and strive to deliver meaningful value at every stage of the customer lifecycle. This role requires a deep understanding of the SimplePractice platform—including core functionality, add\-ons, and evolving product enhancements—and the ability to translate platform capabilities into real\-world outcomes for growing practices.



The ideal candidate excels at building trusted, long\-term customer relationships, understanding complex clinical and operational workflows, and guiding customers toward best practices that drive adoption, efficiency, and growth. Customer Success Managers are expected to quickly learn, articulate, and demonstrate new SimplePractice features and enhancements to help customers realize long\-term value.



This role carries measurable goals related to **retention, feature adoption, practice growth, and overall customer health**.


#### **Responsibilities**


* **Partner with Assigned Customers**
	+ Own the post\-sale relationship for a named portfolio of medium to large group practices
	+ Serve as the primary strategic point of contact and trusted advisor
	+ Conduct regular success check\-ins to understand customer goals, workflows, and evolving needs, and consult on product usage to support those goals
	+ Educate customers on relevant features, enhancements, add\-ons, and best practices, with guidance on applying them to achieve their objectives
* **Drive Retention Through Strategic Relationship Management**
	+ Guide customers through complex questions, workflow optimization, and platform best practices to support growth and account health
	+ Lead customer conversations to address challenges, mitigate risk, improve outcomes, and drive customer health
	+ Provide thoughtful recommendations and alternative workflows tailored to each practice, supporting growth and long\-term success
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Customer Advocacy**
	+ Identify trends, product gaps, and recurring feedback across your portfolio
	+ Partner with Product, Design, and internal teams to advocate for customer needs
	+ Share insights that inform adoption strategies and improve the customer experience
* **Documentation \& Process Adherence**
	+ Maintain clear, detailed documentation on customer goals, health, risks, and outcomes
	+ Follow established internal processes for reporting and collaboration
	+ Adapt quickly as tools, workflows, and processes evolve

#### **Desired Skills \& Experience**


* 3\+ years of experience in **Customer Success, Account Management, or Relationship Management** within a SaaS or technology\-driven environment
* Experience working in **health tech** including EHRs, practice management software, or healthcare SaaS
* Experience working with technology platforms Notion, Slack, Gong and ChurnZero or similar
* Familiarity with healthcare practice workflows and operational considerations
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly
* Proven ability to drive **customer adoption, retention, and long\-term success**
* Strong phone and video communication skills
* Strong problem\-solving and consultative skills
* Comfort collaborating cross\-functionally

#### **Bonus Points**


* You are empathetic, curious, and customer\-focused
* You enjoy solving complex problems and building long\-term relationships
* You are proactive, organized, and accountable for outcomes
* You are comfortable balancing structure with ambiguity

#### **Benefits**



We offer a competitive benefits program including:


* Medical, dental, vision, life \& disability insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Flexible Time Off (FTO), wellbeing days, paid holidays, and summer Fridays
* Mental health resources
* Paid parental leave \& Backup Care
* Tuition reimbursement
* Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

  

  

**California Job Applicant Privacy Notice**



Thank you for your interest in opportunities at SimplePractice LLC ("SimplePractice" or "us" or "we" or "our"). Please note that when you submit your resume or application materials to us for employment purposes, you are subject to the SimplePractice California Job Applicant Privacy Notice.



For more information about our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@simplepractice.com.


**Notice to Candidates**



SimplePractice has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team. We do not have any affiliation or connection to these situations and only post open roles on our official Careers page (simplepractice.com/careers) and reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages.



All official SimplePractice recruitment emails will be sent from the domains @simplepractice.com, no\-reply@greenhouse.io or no‑reply@linkedin.com e

**About Us:**


Span Construction \& Engineering, Inc. is a pioneer in state\-of\-the\-art prefab steel construction, proudly operating as a 100% Employee Owned Company (ESOP) in the building industry. Since our inception in 1980 we've fostered enduring relationships as trusted advisors with our valued clients. We are the number one builder in our field. We are dedicated to providing exceptional engineering and construction services, having successfully completed over 214 million square feet of buildings to date, with ongoing projects 24/6 throughout the year.


Setting the industry standard, we prioritize safety, quality, and integrity in all our endeavors. We are inspired, challenged, and empowered to be and give our best every day, not only because we are each exceptional at what we do, but also because we are surrounded by hungry, humble and smart people.


**Our Benefits:**


* 100% Employee Owned Company (ESOP)
* Competitive pay
* Per diem paid when working away from home
* Medical benefits and 401K
* Opportunities for career advancement


**About the Role:**


Embark on a dynamic journey of growth and success as an Assistant Project Manager. This hands\-on role provides a unique opportunity to delve into project controls, communications, and the technical intricacies of construction, allowing you to gain invaluable experience and lay the foundation for advancing your career in construction project management. You'll collaborate with the Project Manager and other stakeholders, playing a pivotal role in supporting and driving projects to completion. Your contributions will ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in adherence to the highest quality and safety standards.


**Some of the things you will do as an Assistant Project Manager:**


*Project Planning and Coordination:*


* Assist in the development and maintenance of project schedules, ensuring alignment with project objectives and client expectations.
* Coordinate with various teams, including design, engineering, and construction, to facilitate seamless project execution.


*Document Management:*


* Manage and organize project documentation, including contracts, drawings, specifications, and correspondence.
* Ensure that all project records are accurate, up\-to\-date, and accessible to relevant team members.


*Budget Management:*


* Support the monitoring and control of project budgets, tracking expenses, and identifying potential cost\-saving opportunities.
* Collaborate with the finance team to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.


*Quality Assurance and Safety Compliance:*


* Assist in implementing and maintaining quality assurance and safety programs on construction sites.
* Collaborate with the safety team to ensure adherence to industry standards and company policies.


*Communication:*


* Facilitate effective communication between project stakeholders, including clients, subcontractors, and internal teams.
* Prepare and distribute regular project status reports to keep stakeholders informed of progress and any potential issues.
* Leverage project management software for meticulous control and maintenance of records, including contracts, tracking logs, meeting minutes, and submittals.


*Problem Resolution:*


* Identify and address project issues promptly, working with the Project Manager to develop and implement solutions.
* Collaborate with the construction team to ensure that project challenges are resolved efficiently.


**Some of the things we're looking for in an Assistant Project Manager:**


* SWPPP Certification is a big plus!
* Knowledge of Pre\-Engineered Metal Building / Structural Steel Construction
* Tech savviness with proficiency in project management software (Procore, MS Project) and office productivity software (Office 365 Suite).
* Practical working knowledge of construction\-related documentation and processes, (pre\-planning, scheduling, RFPs/RFIs, change orders, tracking, reporting, closeout, etc.,).
* An exceptional communicator.
* Willingness to travel extensively throughout the United States.


***Skills and Abilities***


**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering (or related field), or equivalent combination of technical training and related experience.


**Experience:** Advanced knowledge of construction methods, materials, and legal regulations.


Sound experience with the application of physics and mathematics.


**Computer Skills:** Ability to use a PC, tablet, or laptop. Proficient in suite of Microsoft Office products; PowerPoint, Word, Sage PC, BIM 360, and Excel.


**Certifications \& Licenses:** Because this position requires travel, the employee:


* Must have a valid drivers' license.
* Must be able to be insured on the company's insurance policy as a driver for the company.


Must already have or be able to complete requirements for OSHA 30 certification.


**Other Requirements:** Must be able to receive instruction and supervision. Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills. Regular, timely, predictable, and dependable attendance is required. High level of discernment and the ability to communicate the reason to support your decisions and know when/who to involve when changes and problems arise.
