Every day you'll work directly with homeowners, helping them solve problems and coordinating across teams to ensure they're taken care of. But that's only part of the job. You'll also identify recurring issues, improve workflows, leverage AI to eliminate repetitive work, and partner across the business to make Honey Homes better for both our members and our internal teams.


This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys helping people, loves solving problems, thinks in systems rather than one\-off solutions, and is excited about using AI and technology to fundamentally change how customer operations are run.


This is a hybrid role based in our Oakland headquarters (4 days/week in office).

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own the member journey**


Own member issues from beginning to end across app messaging, phone, SMS, and email. You'll coordinate across teams, communicate proactively, remove blockers, and ensure every member feels taken care of throughout their experience. Solving the immediate problem is expected. Owning the outcome is the standard.

### **Solve today's problems while eliminating tomorrow's**


Every recurring member issue should trigger a deeper question: *Why did this happen? How do we prevent it? Can we automate it? Should we document it? Does another team need to know?* Your job isn't complete when the ticket is resolved. It's complete when you've helped reduce the likelihood another member experiences the same problem.

### **Use AI to multiply your impact**


Leverage AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to eliminate repetitive work, improve documentation, automate workflows, and increase your effectiveness. We expect everyone on the team to actively experiment with new tools, test ideas, and continuously improve how work gets done.

### **Improve the member experience**


Member Success sits at the center of the member experience. You'll partner closely with Sales, Walkthrough Specialists, Field Operations, Billing, Product, Marketing, Recruiting, and other teams to surface trends, advocate for change, and help implement better ways of working. Our responsibility is the entire member journey, not just the conversations that reach our queue.

### **Own a functional area**


In addition to supporting members, every Member Operations Associate owns an area of the business. This might include onboarding, messaging, knowledge management, phone operations, AI tools, NPS, reporting, documentation, or another operational focus area. You'll become the team's subject matter expert and be responsible for continuously improving how that area operates over time.

### **Operate with high agency**


We don't wait for someone else to identify problems. We expect every teammate to proactively find opportunities, propose solutions, build improvements, measure their impact, and share what they've learned. Curiosity, ownership, systems thinking, and continuous improvement aren't nice\-to\-haves—they're core expectations of the role.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Within your first year, you'll:

* Deliver consistently exceptional experiences for Honey Homes members.
* Develop expertise in your operational ownership area and drive measurable improvements.
* Identify recurring member issues and help implement solutions that reduce future support volume.
* Build AI\-powered workflows and automations that improve efficiency across the team.
* Create documentation, SOPs, and knowledge resources that make the organization more effective.
* Become a trusted cross\-functional partner who proactively identifies opportunities to improve operations and follows through on delivering results.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


We're looking for people who care deeply about helping customers but are equally motivated to improve the systems behind the customer experience.


The strongest candidates will bring many of the following:

* 2\+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, operations, hospitality, or another customer\-facing role.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* High agency and a bias toward ownership \- you don't wait to be asked to solve problems.
* Curiosity and a desire to continuously improve how work gets done.
* Comfort learning and using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies to improve productivity.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* The ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams.
* An interest in process improvement, operational excellence, and building scalable systems.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced startup environment is a plus.


The compensation for this role is **$72,000 plus equity**. Because it's part of a structured program, we offer the same compensation package to everyone in the program and therefore is non\-negotiable.

  

*We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Women and under\-represented minorities are encouraged to apply.*

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Sales Associate | Fine Jewelry & Luxury Client Experience
new_jobs.description:
Vardy’s Jewelers is seeking a polished, motivated, and sales\-driven Sales Associate to join our fine jewelry showroom team. This is an opportunity for someone who loves people, luxury, relationship\-based selling, and the art of creating meaningful client experiences.

This role is ideal for someone who is not simply looking for a retail position, but wants to build a long\-term career in fine jewelry sales with the opportunity to grow into future leadership over time.

At Vardy’s, our clients come to us for some of life’s most important moments, including engagements, weddings, anniversaries, milestone gifts, custom jewelry, repairs, and heirloom pieces. We are looking for someone who understands the importance of trust, professionalism, follow\-through, and creating a memorable experience from the first interaction to long after the sale.

**What You’ll Do**

Deliver an Elevated Client Experience

· Welcome clients into the showroom and provide a warm, polished, and personalized experience.

· Assist clients with engagement rings, wedding bands, fine jewelry, custom designs, repairs, special orders, and milestone purchases.

· Build strong client relationships through thoughtful communication, follow\-up, and attention to detail.

· Help clients feel educated, confident, and excited about their purchase.

· Represent Vardy’s Jewelers with professionalism, discretion, and care.

**Drive Sales and Build Client Relationships**

· Work toward individual sales goals while contributing to overall showroom success.

· Proactively follow up with clients, past customers, leads, and inquiries.

· Participate in clienteling, outreach, cold calling, and relationship\-building efforts.

· Look for opportunities to grow business through referrals, community involvement, networking, and local relationship\-building.

· Take ownership of your sales pipeline and demonstrate a strong sense of urgency.

**Learn and Grow in Fine Jewelry**

· Develop strong knowledge of diamonds, gemstones, metals, bridal styles, custom jewelry, repairs, and fine jewelry trends.

· Participate in training and ongoing learning to strengthen product knowledge and sales skills.

· Learn how to guide clients through emotional and high\-value purchasing decisions.

· Stay curious, coachable, and committed to becoming a trusted jewelry professional.

**Support the Showroom and Team**

· Help maintain a beautiful, clean, organized, and luxury\-level showroom environment.

· Assist with displays, merchandising, product presentation, inventory organization, and daily showroom operations.

· Support client appointments, events, promotions, and outreach initiatives.

· Work collaboratively with ownership, management, and the broader team to create a positive and service\-focused environment.

**Long\-Term Growth Opportunity**

For the right person, this role offers the opportunity to grow into a future Sales Manager position. This is not an immediate management role, but we are looking for someone with the potential to develop into a leadership position over time.

As you grow, you may have the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities such as:

· Supporting and coaching sales team members.

· Helping track sales goals and showroom performance.

· Assisting with clienteling strategy and business development efforts.

· Supporting team communication and daily showroom leadership.

· Helping create a goal\-driven, accountable, and client\-focused sales environment.

· Leading by example through strong sales performance, professionalism, and follow\-through.

**Who We’re Looking For**

The ideal candidate is:

· Sales\-driven, ambitious, and motivated by results.

· Warm, personable, and skilled at building relationships.

· Polished, professional, and comfortable in a luxury showroom environment.

· Trustworthy, dependable, and accountable.

· Competitive in a healthy way and motivated to grow.

· Comfortable with client outreach, follow\-up, and community networking.

· Able to work with urgency without sacrificing quality or client experience.

· Detail\-oriented and committed to providing excellent service.

· Coachable, team\-oriented, and eager to learn.

· Interested in a long\-term career opportunity, not just a short\-term job.

**Experience**

Fine jewelry experience is preferred, but not required for the right candidate.

We are open to candidates with strong sales experience in luxury retail, fashion, bridal, beauty, hospitality, watches, high\-end furniture, design, or other client\-facing sales environments.

Ideal experience includes:

· 2\+ years of sales experience required.

· 5\+ years of sales experience preferred.

· Luxury retail, fine jewelry, bridal, or clienteling experience strongly preferred.

· Strong communication and relationship\-building skills.

· Comfort working with sales goals and performance expectations.

· Ability to pass a background check.

**Schedule**

This is a full\-time, in\-person position.

Typical schedule:

· Tuesday through Friday, approximately 10:30 AM to 6:15 PM

· Saturday, approximately 9:30 AM to 5:15 PM

· Occasional evening events, approximately 5 to 6 times per year

**Compensation and Benefits**

Vardy’s Jewelers offers a competitive compensation package, including:

· Hourly compensation starting at $30 per hour, with potential up to $32 per hour based on experience and qualifications.

· Sales incentive opportunities.

· Company\-paid employee health insurance.

· Paid sick time/PTO in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

· Vacation eligibility after the first year.

· SEP IRA retirement contribution.

· Potential discretionary year\-end bonus based on business performance.

· Employee jewelry discounts.

· Hands\-on training and career development.

· Opportunity for long\-term growth into a future leadership role.

**Why Join Vardy’s Jewelers?**

Vardy’s Jewelers is a trusted, family/team\-oriented fine jewelry business where relationships matter,

new_jobs.title: Program Specialist - 5203
new_jobs.description:
BronxWorks helps individuals and families improve their economic and social well\-being. From toddlers to seniors, we feed, shelter, teach, and support our neighbors to build a stronger community. In all aspects of our work, we strive for the highest ethical and performance standards and are guided by the belief that people are to be treated with dignity and respect regardless of their present situation or past experiences.  

  

 Across our 60\+ locations, we provide programs in a variety of service areas, including workforce development, children, youth, families, seniors and homeless prevention.  

The River Park Towers Naturally Occurring Retirement Community (NORC) is seeking a Program Specialist with at least 2 years of working in the social service field. Applicants that have experience working with the senior population are preferred. Duties consist of data entry, scheduling and conducting activities, going on group trips, preparing a monthly report to the director. Workdays are from Monday through Friday\- 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. For consideration, please submit a cover letter and resume to BronxWorks Website: www.bronxworks.org. **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide direct services to clients, including intake, engagement, assessment, referral, service plan development, advocacy, counseling, exit summaries and follow\-up.
* Monitor and document client progress toward service plan goals.
* Conduct home visits and other field work, as required.
* Document all interactions with, or on behalf of, clients.
* Provide general clerical support, including filing, faxing, word processing, typing, photocopying and sorting mail.
* Answer telephones.
* Report to, and meet with, supervisor on a monthly basis.
* Complete program reports on a monthly basis or more frequently as required.
* Assist with special projects as assigned.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

 **PROGRAM RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conduct membership registrations and follow\-up.
* Light Case Assistance.
* Create Monthly Calendar of Activities.
* Create Educational and Recreational activities for senior participants.
* Organize local and out\-of\-state trips.
* Organize and partake in cultural awareness and celebrations.
* Conduct virtual learning activities (e.g. technology, Health \& Wellness, etc.).
* Conduct Outreach Wellness calls to registered members.
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Perform Additional Duties as assigned.

  

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Associate’s degree in a related field of study. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* A minimum of two years of relevant work experience.
* Proficiency in English required; proficiency in a second language preferred.
* Strong oral and written communication, time management and organizational skills are necessary.
* Proficiency in modern business communications including personal computers, electronic mail, voicemail, facsimile and copier equipment

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Ability to use a computer for prolonged periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
* Ability to stand, walk, or sit for long periods of time.
* Ability to climb five flights of stairs, if required to conduct home visits and/or fieldwork.
* Ability to bend and retrieve objects and/or documents.
* Ability to travel in the boroughs of New York City and its adjacent counties via public transportation.

  

BronxWorks is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available to applicants with disabilities and other legally protected needs. To request an accommodation during the application process, please contact hrbenefits@bronxworks.org.

Reporting to Hospice Operations Manager, this role provides comprehensive administrative and coordination support to their assigned Team Manager and Interdisciplinary Group (IDG) team. The Hospice Operations Coordinator facilitates the daily operations of the hospice team by managing communication, scheduling, and documentation activities that support timely, high\-quality patient care. This role ensures smooth coordination between patients, families, staff, and vendors, while upholding VNS Health's standards of compassionate service and operational excellence.  

  

  

**What We Provide**


* Paid time off (PTO) and 9 company holidays
* Health insurance including Medical, Dental, and Vision as part of the 1199 SEIU union membership403(b) retirement savings program

* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement

* Collaborates with the After Hours Supervisiors, Leadership, and Field Staff to support patient admissions, transitions, and coordination of care.
* Coordinates durable medical equipment (DME), pharmacy, and supply requests with approved vendors to ensure timely delivery.
* Prepares, facilitates shift change reports as requested by After Hours leadership
* Monitors patient service documentation for completeness and timeliness; advises appropriate staff of missing and overdue documents.
* Prepares, facilitates shift change reports as requested by After Hours leadership
* Tracks and monitors Plan of Care compliance, ensuring visit frequencies and documentation are completed as required.
* Provides administrative and clerical support including data entry, correspondence, scheduling, and document preparation.
* Reviews patient documentation and verifies completeness of non\-clinical data prior to processing.
* Maintains organized team schedules, calendars, and communication logs to support operational efficiency.
* Develops and maintains streamlined workflows to manage task prioritization and completion.
* Participates in departmental meetings and contributes to quality improvement initiatives.
* Provides exemplary customer service to patients, families, clinicians, and internal staff.
* Manages incoming calls, messages, and inquiries, ensuring timely response and issue resolution.
* Escalates clinical or complex concerns appropriately to the Team Manager or Patient Care Manager.
* Communicates appointment schedules, updates, and changes to patients, caregivers, and field staff.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
  

  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

  

**Education:**  

  

Associate's Degree in Healthcare or related field preferred or
  

  

High School Diploma and equivalent relevant experience considered
  

  

**Work Experience:**
  

  

Minimum of two years of administrative or customer service experience in healthcare or hospice environment required
  

  

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and electronic health record systems (HCHB preferred) preferred
  

  

Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage complex workflows in a fast\-paced setting required
  

  

Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills with strong attention to detail required
  

  

Bilingual skills preferred preferred  

  

  



  

  

**Pay Range**
  

  

USD $29\.12 \- USD $29\.12 /Hr.
  

  

**About Us**
  

  

VNS Health has been committed to meeting the needs of New Yorkers for over 130 years. We’re one of the largest nonprofit home\- and community\-based health care organizations in the country, and today, more than 11,500 team members work together to make a difference in the lives of more than 99,000 patients and members on any given day.

new_jobs.title: Talent Operations Specialist, Emerging Talent
new_jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


Emerging Talent is an important part of how Ramp builds for the long term. It gives us the opportunity to meet exceptional people early, build relationships before they enter the broader talent market, and develop the next generation of Ramp talent.


We’re hiring an Emerging Talent Operations Associate to help run the operational foundation behind our internship and new\-grad programs. You’ll partner with recruiters, coordinators, hiring managers, People Ops, and IT to keep candidate data, interviews, offers, onboarding, and intern support moving smoothly.


You’ll help create an exceptional experience from a candidate’s first interaction with Ramp through offer and, for interns, potential conversion to full\-time. This is a hands\-on role for someone organized and resourceful who enjoys making complex programs feel seamless. As you learn the work, you’ll help improve processes, templates, and simple automations.

**This is a temporary, full\-time role with strong potential to convert to a permanent full\-time position.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Support daily operations across the internship and new\-grad recruiting lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate candidate, event, and program data in Ashby.
* Partner with recruiting coordinators on candidate communications during high\-volume periods.
* Support job and offer administration, including requisitions, approvals, and documentation.
* Help coordinate onboarding, access, housing, and other intern and new\-hire needs.
* Track recurring work, flag risks early, and keep important details from slipping.
* Improve team templates, checklists, and operating processes.
* Identify repetitive work that could be simplified with AI or practical automation.
* During slower operational periods, support program management.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent or program operations, university recruiting, events, or another detail\-heavy service role. Equivalent experience is welcome.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and attention to detail.
* Clear, warm communication, timely updates, and reliable follow\-through.
* Comfort managing shifting priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Curiosity about learning new tools and improving how work gets done.
* Good judgment, ownership, and a habit of raising issues early.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Ashby, Greenhouse, or another applicant\-tracking system.
* Familiarity working with Talent, People Ops, IT, Workplace, or Payroll.
* Experience improving a process, tracker, template, or workflow.

*Don’t check every box? We’d still love to hear from you. Care, curiosity, and strong follow\-through matter most.*

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**

**THE ROLE**
Win \- Women in Need is seeking a detail\-oriented and organized Development Operations Coordinator to support the daily operations of our development team. * Excellent judgment, attention to detail, and a practical, solutions\-oriented approach.
* Clear and professional communication skills, with confidence working across employees, senior leaders, visitors, vendors, and building partners.

new_jobs.description:
The Jerome L. Greene Performance Space at WNYC \& WQXR is looking for a **Live Events Production Coordinator** to join our The Green Space (TGS). The Greene Space is the live public embodiment of WNYC, WQXR and WNYC Studios' shows, as well as a producer of our own original programming . We produce 50\+ programs each season for in house and digital audiences, including discussions, debates, concerts, game shows, podcast tapings, and theatrical productions. The Greene Space also operates as a rental venue, hosting events for external clients and partners.  

The **Live Events Production Coordinator** supports the planning and execution of live events, including ticketed programming, show events, internal events, and rentals. Working closely with the Director of Event Operations and the rest of the Events team, show teams, clients, and internal partners, the Coordinator helps ensure events are well organized, properly staffed, and successfully executed from initial planning through event wrap. This position reports to the Director of Events and Venue Operations.

new_jobs.description:
The stunning Forbes 4\-Star **Conrad New York Downtown** is looking for a **Sales Coordinator** to join the Sales Team!


Stay inspired and join the pinnacle of luxury in the heart of Lower Manhattan, featuring 463 rooms, 30,000 square feet of banquet space, and 3 food and beverage outlets. This includes a 3\-meal restaurant, rooftop bar, and in\-room dining.


***Want to learn more?*** Hotel Website , Instagram, Facebook, YouTube  



**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a **Sales Coordinator** , you’re not just supporting sales operations and lead generation to help drive new business – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.


  
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:


* **Perform daily sales operations:** Provide administrative support including data entry, invoice distribution, Salesforce activity tracking, and recordkeeping to ensure efficient team operations
* **Support sales documentation and reporting:** Assist with preparing contracts, proposals, RFP responses, client call summaries, and booking and loyalty reports
* **Generate and qualify new business leads:** Research, identify, and evaluate unmanaged and prospect accounts to build and maintain a qualified pipeline
* **Build collaborative relationships:** Partner with Hilton Worldwide Sales peers, customers, and hotel partners to identify and qualify new opportunities, conduct discovery calls for unmanaged accounts, and deliver tailored solutions
* **Assist with special projects and events:** Support departmental initiatives, customer engagement activities, and participation in meetings and conferences as needed

  
**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:


A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.


  
**How We'll Help You Thrive**

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:


* **Incredible travel perks** – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
* **Own a piece of Hilton** – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
* **Paid parental leave** – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
* **Personalized caregiving support** – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
* **Crisis concierge** – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
* **Mental health resources** – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best\-in\-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* **Generous paid time off (PTO)** – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
* **Health \& welfare benefits** – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
* **Financial security for your future** – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next

*\*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.*


  
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**  

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

NYC Department of Finance (DOF) is responsible for administering the tax revenue laws of the city fairly, efficiently, and transparently to instill public confidence and encourage compliance while providing exceptional customer service.  

  

DOF’s The Tax Audit and Enforcement Division is charged with the audit of all business and excise taxes administered by New York City. The division conducts audits related to corporate, personal, sales, and use taxes. City tax auditors conduct audits of selected audit candidates with a goal of determining the appropriate tax liability of each taxpayer and applying NYC rules and laws in accordance with the City’s policies and procedures.  

  

The Office of Tax Audit is charged with the audit of all business and excise taxes administered by the City of New York. Tax Audit conducts audits of general corporation tax, business corporation tax, commercial rent tax, unincorporated business tax, hotel tax, utility tax, real property transfer tax, and bank tax. Tax Audit also conducts NYC personal income tax and sales and use tax audits within New York City. Tax auditors conduct audits of selected candidates in the various administered taxes, with a goal of determining the appropriate tax liability of each taxpayer. The Office of Tax Audit includes the Field Unit, which conducts audits in the field, and the Non\-field Unit, which conducts correspondence audits.  

  

The Audit Case Analysis and Reporting/Review \& Quality Control Unit (ACAR/RQC) of the Tax Audit Division has an excellent promotional opportunity available for a highly motivated, organized and detail\-oriented individual to serve as an Administrative Operations Coordinator of the Unit. Reporting to the Director of the Tax Audit, the selected candidates’ duties and responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:  

  

* Coordinate, compile and process the typing and mailing of statutory \& non\-statutory notices for all closed audits conducted by the Department’s Audit and Enforcement Division. Prepare complete mailing packages along with their related notices and attachments.
* Reconcile the mailed documents to the daily mail log and trace them to their related postal receipts. Document and trouble shoot discrepancies and communicate in a clear concise manner with the mailroom staff to resolve issues.
* Maintain complete, detailed records of all mailed notices and their related certified receipts for quick reference.
* Compile respective Statement of Audit Adjustment (A21\.5\) and submit it neatly and timely to the New York State representative monthly.
* Train all new Clerical Support staff members in the numerous tasks conducted by the Unit.
* Coordinate with the various Unit’s clerical support staff to document, file and return all incoming and outgoing completed cases. Maintain detailed records.
* Monitor and maintain equipment and supply needs and request, accordingly, ensuring that supplies are always on hand. Report and trouble shoot computer, printer and scanner related problems.
* Retrieve all relevant legal documents, case folder, and receipts based on the request of the Conciliation Bureau.
* Perform general office administrative functions and special projects requested by the Director.
* Independently develop and create reports for the Director. Such work may include but is not limited to staff related reports.


  

Additional Information:  

  

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.  

  

This position may be eligible for remote work up to 2 days per week, pursuant to the Remote Work Pilot Program agreed between the City and the Collective Bargaining Unit representing employees serving in the civil service title.  

  

PRINCIPAL ADMINISTRATIVE ASSOC \- 10124 **Qualifications**  

1\. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of satisfactory full\-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience, one year of which must have been in an administrative capacity or supervising staff performing clerical/administrative work of more than moderate difficulty; or  

  

2\. An associate degree or 60 semester credits from an accredited college and three years of satisfactory full\-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience including one year of the administrative supervisory experience described in "1" above; or  

  

3\. A four\-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent approved by a state’s department of education or a recognized accrediting organization and four years of satisfactory full\-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience including one year of the administrative supervisory experience as described in "1" above; or  

  

4\. Education and/or experience equivalent to "1", "2", or "3" above. However, all candidates must possess the one year of administrative or supervisory experience as described in "1" above. Education above the high school level may be substituted for the general clerical/administrative experience (but not for the one year of administrative or supervisory experience described in "1" above) at a rate of 30 semester credits from an accredited college for 6 months of experience up to a maximum of 3 year.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager for Internal Creative Agency
new_jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**About Skyline**
-----------------


Skyline is Citi’s U.S. internal creative agency — a full\-service partner offering Strategy, Creative, Data \& Insights, AI, and Operations capabilities to business partners across the firm. Skyline's purpose is to help Citi's businesses communicate more effectively, reach their audiences, and demonstrate measurable impact. As Skyline evolves, the Account Management function is expanding its remit: moving upstream from campaign execution to strategic partnership, and from project facilitation to proactive internal intelligence and opportunity development.


**Role Purpose**
----------------


The Strategic Account Manager builds strong, proactive partnerships between Skyline and its internal marketing partners by developing a deep understanding of marketing partners business priorities, translating those priorities into creative and strategic opportunities, and connecting marketing partners with the right Skyline capabilities across Creative, Data \& Insights, and Operations. This role serves as the strategic bridge between the marketing partners and Skyline — helping the agency move upstream from receiving requests to identifying needs, shaping solutions, and demonstrating the value Skyline delivers across the account.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Internal Client Partnership \& Intelligence**


* Build and maintain trusted stakeholder relationships across assigned internal business partners, engaging beyond individual projects to develop a holistic understanding of the marketing partners’ business
* Develop deep knowledge of the internal client's objectives, upcoming priorities, audience needs, decision\-making environment, and organizational dynamics
* Capture and document relevant partner signals, recurring needs, challenges, and emerging priorities to maintain a consolidated, living view of the account
* Bring internal client intelligence back into Skyline to inform planning, capability development, and proactive outreach

### **Opportunity Development**


* Identify opportunities where Skyline can become involved earlier in the marketing partners planning cycle or provide broader, more integrated support
* Maintain the account Opportunity Tracker, capturing outreach activity, potential work, expected business impact, and next actions
* Connect opportunities across teams, products, and lines of business where appropriate
* Partner with Strategy, Creative and Data \& Insights to develop proactive recommendations
* Support the appropriate growth of the account relationship and help reduce unnecessary reliance on external agencies

### **Strategic Intake \& Solution Shaping**


* Lead intake conversations that help marketing partners clarify the business problem before work moves into execution
* Determine whether a request requires a single deliverable, a broader campaign, research, data support, or a different Skyline solution
* Bring the right Skyline experts into the conversation early to shape the response
* Improve brief quality by ensuring objectives, audience, desired outcomes, context, and measures of success are clearly defined before handoff to delivery teams
* Constructively challenge or redirect requests when a different approach would create greater value for our marketing partners

### **Account Planning \& Governance**


* Maintain a structured account plan covering internal client priorities, stakeholders, active and future work, relationship health, risks, and opportunities
* Lead strategic account reviews focused on intelligence, decisions, opportunities, and risks — distinct from project status updates
* Coordinate with Operations on capacity implications, prioritization, and portfolio\-level visibility
* Escalate account\-level risks proactively, before they affect the relationship or delivery quality
* Contribute account insights to the broader Internal Client Intelligence Hub and to Skyline leadership reporting

### **Value \& Impact Storytelling**


* Partner with Data \& Insights and Operations to capture and communicate evidence of Skyline's business impact
* Connect completed work to measurable business outcomes — including internal client satisfaction, efficiency gains, cost savings, and increased internal adoption
* Help identify potential case studies, proof points, and leadership narratives that demonstrate Skyline's strategic value
* Use account insights and performance information to recommend next steps and future opportunities
* Help marketing partners understand the full value of Skyline's capabilities beyond the individual deliverable

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
-----------------------------------


* Skyline is involved earlier in internal client planning cycles — not only at the point of an execution request
* More opportunities are proactively identified and converted into work, tracked through the Opportunity Tracker
* Marketing partners engage with more Skyline capabilities — not just Creative — reflecting deeper strategic integration
* Strategic account reviews produce decisions and actions, not status updates
* Skyline can demonstrate measurable business value and internal client impact beyond campaign delivery metrics
* Internal client satisfaction and internal adoption improve across assigned accounts
* Account risks and opportunities are visible and addressed at the leadership level before they become issues
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance w

Agora is a leading SaaS and FinTech platform transforming how real estate investment firms manage their capital, investors, and operations. Trusted by 700\+ GPs, owners/operators, and investment firms globally, we help teams streamline the full lifecycle of investment management—from fundraising and onboarding to reporting, distributions, tax, and back\-office automation.


But we’re more than just software. We’re a team of bold thinkers, innovators, and real estate enthusiasts who believe complex processes should feel simple. Our platform combines modern technology with expert services, helping our customers raise more capital, deliver a better investor experience, and scale their businesses smarter.


Agora is backed by top\-tier VCs like Insight Partners and Qumra Capital, and we’re growing fast. We’ve been named one of Globes’ Most Promising Startups, recognized as a Best Start\-Up Companies to Work For by Duns 100, and one of Business Insider’s Hottest PropTech Startups.

**About the role:**


﻿We're hiring an SDR Team Lead to lead our New York outbound Sales Development team of 6\-8 SDRs. You'll own the team's qualified\-meeting and pipeline results, coach every rep to get better every week, and hire and onboard new SDRs as we grow into 2027\.


This is a first leadership step for a top\-performing Senior SDR or BDR who has consistently hit their numbers, earned a promotion, and is ready to lead. If you've been mentoring newer reps and want to turn that into a real management role, this is it. You'll stay close to the work, too: when the team needs it, you'll pick up the phone and book meetings alongside them.

  


Requirements:  

  

**Required**

**﻿**

* 2\+ years in outbound sales development (SDR/BDR). Inbound experience is a plus, but outbound is a must.
* A consistent track record of hitting or beating quota
* At least one promotion earned through performance (for example, SDR to Senior SDR)
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to give clear feedback and represent the team to sales leadership
* Comfortable reading activity, conversion, and pipeline dashboards and turning the numbers into action
* Based in the New York City area and able to work from our Chelsea office 4\-5 days per wee**k**

 **Nice to have**

**﻿**

* Experience selling a complex product: commercial real estate, fintech, proptech, or another vertical SaaS with a sophisticated buyer
* Formal or informal experience mentoring other SDRs (onboarding new hires, running role\-plays, or a rep reporting to you)
* Has built or improved an outbound playbook or cadence
* Experience with a CRM and sales engagement tools. We use HubSpot, Amplemarket, and Orum, but any comparable tools are great. We'll train you on ours.

 **How you work**

**﻿**

* You lead from the front. You take initiative, act without waiting for direction, and bring energy and positivity to the office every day.
* You give direct, frequent feedback. Coaching is a daily habit, not a once\-a\-quarter event, and you always close the loop.
* You use data to coach, not to replace the conversation. Numbers help you have better conversations with reps. You're not managing by dial count alone.
* You build people. You see the SDR seat as a path to AE and measure your success by your reps' growth and promotions.
* You thrive in a competitive environment. You're comfortable on a quota\-carrying floor and keep morale high through slower months.

 **Why you'll love working at Agora**

**﻿**

* Comprehensive health insurance
* Unlimited paid time off
* Stock options and ownership opportunities
* Commuter and lunch benefits
* Team events, offsites, and an energetic company culture
* Real opportunities for personal and professional growth

  

We're here for people who dream big, take ownership, and treat others with kindness and respect, while building something exceptional, together.

 **Compensation**


The base salary for this role starts at $80,000 and is negotiable based on experience. The role also includes commission tied to team quota attainment, with total compensation generally structured as a 70/30 base\-to\-variable split, plus stock options and benefits.

  

What are we looking for:  

  

We're looking for a top\-performing Senior SDR or BDR who is ready to step into leadership and be:

 **A coach who makes the team better**

**﻿**

* Runs weekly 1:1s with each SDR on pipeline, activity, and blockers
* Coaches hands\-on across phone, email, and LinkedIn, using call reviews, live call listening, message reviews, and role\-play on objection handling and cold outreach
* Gives direct, frequent feedback and always follows up to make sure it turns into real change
* Leads from the front, sets the energy in the office, and jumps into prospecting when the team needs it

 **An owner of the team's numbers**

**﻿**

* Takes ownership of weekly, monthly, and quarterly attainment against qualified\-meeting and pipeline targets
* Sets clear goals and tracks activity, conversion, and quality metrics per rep (calls, sequences, meetings booked, meetings held, meeting\-to\-opportunity conversion)
* Spots underperformance early and leads improvement plans when needed
* Reports team performance to the Senior SDR Manager, celebrates wins, and addresses challenges quickly so every SDR knows their impact

 **A team builder**

**﻿**

* Partners with the People team to hire great SDRs for the New York team
* Owns onboarding and ramp for every new SDR who joins

 **A strong partner across teams**

**﻿**

* Keeps outbound playbooks, cadences, and enablement materials sharp and up to date
* Works with AE Team Leads to keep the SDR\-to\-AE handoff clean and meeting quality high
* Partners with Marketing and Revenue Operations on messaging, data hygiene, and reporting

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative - Laboratory Diagnostic Instrument Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution (“GMPD”) segment, focuses on U.S. and International Products and Distribution businesses. We offer industry expertise and an expanding portfolio of safe, effective medical products that improve quality, manage costs and reduce complexity. With our trusted regulatory experience, insights, and infrastructure, we help manufacture and source medical products that meet the demand for value\-driven, comprehensive healthcare solutions.  



  

**Job Summary:**


As diagnostic testing continues to advance, Cardinal Health Clinical Laboratory Products and Services is evolving to support the needs of hospital labs, reference labs, government labs and labs in non\-acute care settings. Our commitment to supply chain resiliency enables us to navigate global supply challenges to deliver the products where and when our customers need them.


The **Lab Diagnostic Sales Specialist** is responsible for managing the sales process of capital equipment in the clinical laboratory to include lead generation, financial modeling, working closely with our manufacturer partners to close system sales in chemistry, immunology, histology, microbiology, hematology, and molecular diagnostics within assigned region territory.  



  

**Territory:** Northeast US (MA, NH, VT, NYC, RI, NJ, CT)

 **Responsibilities:**

* Identify and qualify new sales opportunities and develop plans for introducing new solutions through collaborative relationships with manufacturers and Lab Product Representatives.
* Execute on business opportunities and maintain a robust pipeline across the diagnostic instrumentation portfolio.
* Manage the end\-end sales process of capital equipment in the clinical laboratory to include lead generation, financial modeling, working closely with our manufacturer partners to close system sales in chemistry, immunology, histology, microbiology, hematology, and molecular diagnostics within assigned region.
* Effectively provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution. Provide in\-depth technical expertise.
* Assist customers in achieving defined business and technical goals. These responsibilities will include pre \& post analysis review.
* Deliver tailored presentations specific to customer needs incorporating the outcome data from the various process analysis. Conduct system demonstrations \& presentations where applicable, Road Shows, Site Visits, etc.
* Applies knowledge of the customer’s business and laboratory instrumentation portfolio to present solutions that improve lab workflow efficiency, test accuracy and patient outcomes.
* Effectively negotiates and collaborates with the customer, supplier partners and internal constituents to influence support for mutually beneficial outcomes and achieve consensus.
* Build and sustain relationships founded on trust with internal and external customers and ensures customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Complete all administrative tasks \& training including expense reports, pipeline, maintain accurate SFDC records, market feedback, etc.
* Attend and participate in sales meetings, training programs, conventions, and trade shows as directed.
* Meet and maintain the requirements of all key vendor credentialing entities.
* Maintain knowledge of the current industry / competitive landscape including, GPOs, healthcare economics, reimbursement, competitors and competitive products etc.
* Travel within assigned region. Maintain active, in\-person presence.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or relevant experience preferred
* Sales Experience in Laboratory industry, selling capital equipment or laboratory equipment into hospitals and reference laboratories strongly preferred
* Functional understanding of Laboratory workflow and process
* Experience working in complex sales environments with demonstrated success
* Successful negotiation, strategic planning, and organizational skills
* Strong ability to multi\-task and manage the sales process with many competing priorities
* Entrepreneurial spirit, strong business acumen, and a desire to conquer complex sales processes
* Strong communication \& listening skills
* Ability to travel up to 75% of the time
* A valid driver's license issued in one of the 50 States with a clean driving record
* Experience working with Microsoft applications (excel) and aptitude to use various business tools (i.e. salesforce).
* Customer/vendor credentialing is required (this may include vaccinations). More details will be provided if you are selected for an interview.

 **Anticipated pay range:** $140,200 \- $161,660 (includes targeted variable pay)


**Bonus eligible:** Yes


**Benefits:** Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well\-being.


* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* Paid time off plan
* Health savings account (HSA)
* 401k savings plan
* Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
* Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
* Short\- and long\-term disability coverage
* Work\-Life resources
* Paid parental leave
* Healthy lifestyle programs

  



**Application window anticipated to close:** 10/25/2026 \*if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

**A. Internal:** Marketing and Member Business Group**,** Executive Area, Information Technology, Web content providers and Community Investment.

**B. External:** Web Content Management System and CRM System vendors

* Preferably 3 to 5 years\+ of hands\-on digital marketing execution experience, preferably in an in\-house or corporate environment; financial experience is a plus.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated digital marketing campaigns across email and web channels.
* Strong experience building, maintaining, and optimizing websites and digital experiences; portfolio required.
* Hands\-on experience creating, deploying and optimizing email communications and campaigns in a marketing automation platform (e.g., Eloqua, Marketo, or similar) integrated with a CRM system.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders to gather, refine, and publish content for digital channels.
* Experience using analytics tools to evaluate campaign and website perfor

new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Oak Park, Illinois


**Business Unit:** Rush Medical Center


**Hospital:** Rush University Medical Center


**Department:** Cancer Center\-Res Fac


**Work Type:** Full Time (Total FTE between 0\.9 and 1\.0\)


**Shift: Shift 1**

**Work Schedule:** 8 Hr (8:00:00 AM \- 5:00:00 PM)


**Rush offers exceptional rewards and benefits learn more at our** Rush benefits page (https://www.rush.edu/rush\-careers/employee\-benefits).


**Pay Range:** $27\.47 \- $38\.81 per hour
  

Rush salaries are determined by many factors including, but not limited to, education, job\-related experience and skills, as well as internal equity and industry specific market data. The pay range for each role reflects Rush’s anticipated wage or salary reasonably expected to be offered for the position. Offers may vary depending on the circumstances of each case.


This position is located at Rush Oak Park Hospital in Oak Park, IL.


Summary:
  

The Clinical Research Coordinator II (CRC II) independently coordinates assigned aspects of clinical research studies across a range of disciplines. Responsibilities include participant recruitment and retention, study data management, regulatory documentation submission and maintenance, communication with sponsors and institutional stakeholders, and monitoring of study compliance. The CRC II executes study protocols with increasing independence, identifies and resolves routine operational issues, contributes to process improvements, and may assist in mentoring less experienced staff.
  

Exemplifies the Rush mission, vision and values and acts in accordance with Rush policies and procedures.


Required Job Qualifications:
  

Education:
  

* Bachelor’s degree

Experience:
  

* 2\+ years of experience coordinating clinical trials
* Independent site management experience

OR
  

Experience (in lieu of a degree)
  

* 3 years total experience in coordinating clinical trials with increasing complexity

  

Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:
  

* Regulatory Knowledge – Understands Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and proper research documentation.
* Regulatory Compliance – Knows the basic rules and guidelines from NIH and FDA that apply to research.
* Project \& Time Management – Can manage timelines, keep track of tasks, and handle several study activities at once.
* Problem\-Solving \& Judgment – Can figure out solutions when challenges come up and make thoughtful decisions.
* Detail \& Organization – Pays close attention to detail and keeps study data and records well organized.
* Participant \& Vendor Interaction – Builds trust with participants and communicates respectfully with sponsors and outside partners.
* Communication Skills – Speaks and writes clearly when sharing information with research teams, participants, or external groups.
* Teamwork – Works well with other staff and helps solve problems as part of the team.
* Flexibility – Willing to work evenings or weekends if the study requires it.
* Travel Readiness – Able to travel locally or nearby for study visits, participant support, or training.

  

Preferred Job Qualifications:
  

Experience:
  

* 2\-5 years’ experience in clinical research conduct, regulatory management, or research administration

  

Certifications:
  

* Relevant certification strongly preferred (Certified Clinical Research Professionals (CCRP),
* Certified Clinical Research Associate (CCRA),
* Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC), OR
* Certified IRB Professional (CIP)
Job Responsibilities:
  

1\. Coordinates all aspects of the study including recruitment, consent, screening, scheduling, tracking, and provides study updates to study participants throughout the conduct of the study.
  

2\. May collect and enter data into study case report forms and/or electronic data capture system and respond to queries in a timely manner.
  

3\. Independently submits or partners with a regulatory coordinator to submit study related documents, study protocols, and study protocol amendments to the IRB per policy and procedure, with increasing autonomy over time to prepare for independent regulatory management responsibilities.
  

4\. Ensures procedural documentation is accurate, complete, and in compliance with institutional, local, state, and federal guidelines and regulations related to clinical research.
  

5\. Verifies and ensures that data is consistent with 100% of source documentation before entry into case report forms and electronic data capture systems to support accuracy, timeliness, and audit readiness.
  

6\. May collect, process, and ship potentially biohazardous specimens.
  

7\. May administer more complex structured tests and questionnaires according to research study protocols, including providing protocol\-specific education to participants regarding procedures and expectations. May utilize study\-related technology and equipment as part of assessment procedures.
  

8\. Provides ongoing study status updates, responds to questions, and may create summary report(s) for distribution to the PI, Administrator, department stakeholders, Sponsor, and Compliance throughout the conduct of the study.
  

9\. Organizes and participates in auditing and monitoring visits.
  

10\. Monitors participant interactions for protocol deviations, adverse events (AEs), and serious adverse events (SAEs), and reports findings per institutional and regulatory guidelines.
  

11\. Partners with PI(s), sponsor, compliance, clinical staff, and manager to identify and improve more complex processes as it relates to the conduct of the research study.
  

12\. May provide oversight, training, and coaching to less experienced staff.
  

13\. Other duties as assigned.  

  



Rush is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

**Company Description**  

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient\-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description** **Work Hours: Monday \- Friday, 8am to 5pm**


The **Administrative Coordinator** position reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.


The Administrative Coordinator is responsible for higher\-level administrative support to various directors within the organization and must use independent judgment and authority to execute projects and maintain workflow. The incumbent will work as part of team and demonstrate superior organization skills, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and attention to detail proficient Microsoft application skills (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and be highly flexible and adaptable.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Independently performs high level technical and administrative work supporting the division or unit.
* Serves as a project manager for a variety of special projects; conducts special studies and analyses and makes recommendations to resolve organizational, procedural and system problems.
* Creates and revises systems and procedures by analyzing operating practices, record\-keeping systems, forms control, supplies inventory, and office layout.
* Implements changes independently for areas of responsibility. For issues outside responsibility, makes recommendations and, following managerial review, implements changes.
* Uses organizational software applications to research and prepare documents and presentations. Collects, analyzes, and manage data.
* Manages calendar; sets meeting priorities; identifies objectives of meetings and identifies materials needed for meeting; exercises judgment to ensure appropriate parties attend meeting.
* Screens incoming email, mail and telephone calls to assign priority, route as needed, identify additional resources needed to address and/or respond to the communication.
* Independently plans and executes events, activities, and meetings.
* Assists with creation, preparation, and distribution of materials to be presented to all levels of organizational staff.
* Reads, researches, and routes correspondence while maintaining security and confidentiality of highly sensitive information.
* Authors responses on behalf of director or department
* Develops and maintains relationships with all internal and external customers including patients, providers, staff and vendors.
* Records meeting discussions by attending meetings and recording key discussions and conclusions.
* May perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications** **Required****:**

* Associates Degree or equivalent relevant (administrative) experience
* 3\-5 years’ experience in a business office with a strong emphasis on database management and customer service.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, PowerPoint and Excel.
* Ability to organize and think independently.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.

**Preferred****:**

* Bachelor of Arts degree or business equivalent.
* 5 years business experience.

  

**Additional Information**  

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

**Artificial Intelligence Disclosure**

new_jobs.title: Rare Conditions Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Location: Chicago, IL, United States  

Date Updated: Sep 25, 2026  

Job ID: 18561


  
**Description**


Ascendis Pharma is a dynamic, fast\-growing global biopharmaceutical company with locations in Denmark, Europe, and the United States. Today, we're advancing programs in Endocrinology, Rare Disease and Oncology.


Here at Ascendis, we pride ourselves on exceptional science, visionary leadership, and skilled and passionate colleagues.


Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we use our TransCon® drug development platform to fulfill our mission of developing new and potentially best\-in\-class therapies to address unmet medical needs.


Our culture fosters a place where skilled, adaptable, and highly resourceful professionals can truly make their mark. We offer a dynamic workplace for employees to grow and develop their skills.


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced **Rare Condition Account Manager (RCAM)** to lead key relationships in the rare disease space, engaging with high value HCP’s, executives, and other key stakeholders within Top Centers of Excellence in assigned Region. This individual will have a primary focus on establishing long term strategic partnerships with key centers in assigned region by driving education and awareness of Ascendis Rare Conditions portfolio, calling on Pediatric Endocrinologists, Genetists, Orthopedics, \& Pediatrics with demonstrated experience accessing and exceeding key metrics within large health care systems.


This role is critical to driving therapy adoption through education, patient reimbursement and support, and long\-term value creation in complex therapeutic and health care system environments. The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of the dynamics specific to rare diseases, including limited patient populations, distribution networks, and evolving competitive landscapes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for building and maintaining strategic relationships within assigned targeted health systems by driving education and awareness through expert product and disease state knowledge that allows them to engage in appropriate face\-to\-face clinical dialogue with healthcare professionals
* Effectively promote approved indications and product efficacy/safety profiles to support on\-label prescribing for appropriate patients
* Develop and execute a territory business plan to achieve or exceed quarterly MBO metrics
* Partner effectively with cross functional team members in assigned Region to identify and engage with key external stakeholders i.e.. physicians, administrative staff, nurses, care coordinators, and pharmacists to drive adoption of Ascendis products within large health systems
* Lead cross\-functional planning efforts to optimize regional impact through access and adoption of rare disease therapies and identify referral networks within assigned customer segments
* Work collaboratively with internal teams (Patient Services, Marketing, Medical Affairs, HEOR, Market Access) to ensure alignment of goals and execution
* Provide field insights on emerging treatment trends, patient’s needs, and competitor activity to internal stakeholders
* Stay current on rare disease market trends, policy developments (e.g., orphan drug policy), patient advocacy, and competitive activity.
* Experience launching or supporting ultra rare disease products
* Strong understanding of specialty drug (rare/orphan disease) environment to ensure customers’ and patients’ needs Ability to travel 70% and cover a large geographic area

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
* 5\+ years of experience in strategic account management, market access, or health system\-based sales in the rare disease, biotech, or specialty pharma sector
* Proven ability to engage and influence high level stakeholders in key centers of excellence and academic institutions establishing measurable impact on product access and revenue growth
* Demonstrated use of product knowledge to engage in customized discussions and in\-person interactions based on customer’s needs in a compliant and ethical manner
* Documented track record of consistent top performance
* Strong knowledge of rare disease market dynamics, including distribution, patient support, high\-touch care coordination, and innovative reimbursement models
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills
* Strong clinical and business acumen with the ability to craft compelling clinical patient focused solutions
* Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and strategic account planning frameworks.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with integrated delivery networks (IDNs), PBMs, and specialty pharmacy operations.
* Proven success of balancing a product portfolio


The annual base salary for this position is **$195,000 – $215,000**. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and/or individual performance.

Rensa Filtration is seeking a motivated Inside Sales Representative to manage and grow an assigned book of business. This is a phone\-forward sales position focused on developing customer relationships, re\-engaging inactive accounts, uncovering new opportunities, and expanding revenue across Rensa’s filtration products and brands.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple customers, tasks, quotes, and follow\-up dates
* Experience using a CRM to document activity and manage opportunities
* Strong organization, time\-management, and follow\-through
* Ability to ask effective discovery questions and identify customer needs
* Comfortable being measured against activity, pipeline, and revenue goals
